name: v4.67.12
body: ### Bug fixes - A quoted `set_env` value that ends with a literal backslash and contains a semicolon no longer loses its quote protection, so `WINPATH="C:\tools;C:\bin\\"` keeps the whole value instead of failing with `invalid marker`. tox now counts the backslashes in front of a quote: an even number leaves the quote unescaped ([#4388](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4388)) by @haigou-web and @gaborbernat. ([#4387](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4387)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.67.12/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.67.11...4.67.12)

name: v4.67.11
body: ### Bug fixes - Package staging no longer fails on a `.tox` that only the project's own writers can change, such as one owned by the workspace owner while root runs tox, or a `777` build directory on Bitbucket. A work directory that other accounts could change, such as a `777` `.tox` left by an older tox under umask `000` or restored from a CI cache, is made private and emptied once at the start of a run, so tox recreates its environments instead of failing. When staging still refuses a path, the error names its owner and mode ([#4386](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4386)) by @gaborbernat. ([#4376](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4376)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.67.11/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.67.10...4.67.11)

name: v4.67.10
body: ### Bug fixes - A pair of numbers after a `-` is no longer read as a range, so `py-django-4-2` keeps its name instead of splitting into `py-django-4`, `3` and `2`. Braced ranges such as `py-django-{4-5}` still expand ([#4380](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4380)) by @ericdelorefice and @gaborbernat. - On Windows, quoted option values in requirements files and `deps`, such as `-r "sub dir/base.txt"`, now have their quotes removed as they do on other platforms and in pip; before, the quotes stayed in the path and the file could not be opened. On every platform, a quoted `-r`, `-c` or `-f` value in `deps` keeps its spaces as written instead of gaining literal backslashes ([#4381](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4381)) by @abo3losh1 and @gaborbernat. ### New Contributors - @abo3losh1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4381 [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.67.10/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.67.9...4.67.10)

name: v4.67.8
body: ### Bug fixes - A `.tox` created under umask `002` no longer fails the package staging check. When the current user owns a group-writable work directory left by an older tox, tox makes it owner-only and removes group write from the staging directories inside it. Provisioning runs the same repair before starting the provisioned tox, which may be a release without it, and creates a missing work directory owner-only. Previously, such checkouts failed until `.tox` was deleted, and a fresh `.tox` also failed when tox provisioned itself ([#4377](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4377)) by @gaborbernat. ([#4376](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4376)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.67.8/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.67.7...4.67.8)

name: v4.67.7
body: ### Bug fixes - PEP 723 metadata lines with content now require a space after `#`. Empty blocks count when detecting duplicates, and invalid `requires-python` values report a configuration error. Previously, malformed content lines could make tox read metadata that other script runners ignored ([#4371](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4371)) by @abhishekcpp007 and @gaborbernat. ### New Contributors - @abhishekcpp007 made their first contribution in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4371 [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.67.7/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.67.6...4.67.7)

name: v4.67.6
body: ### Bug fixes - Package builds now work under umasks such as `0002` because tox creates new staging directories and missing parents with owner-only access. Existing directories keep their permissions ([#4360](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4360)) by @stephenfin and @gaborbernat. - `tox config` no longer fails with an `AssertionError` when an environment uses a runner whose plugin is not installed. It skips that environment, as `tox run` and `tox list` already do ([#4361](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4361)) by @nk-batman21 and @gaborbernat. - Invalid `set_env` markers now report the key. For INI values, the error explains how to write a literal semicolon as `\;` ([#4364](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4364)) by @faresrafat3 and @gaborbernat. - Restore built-in runner choices for `--runner` so `--runner virtualenv` does not fail with an empty choices list ([#4365](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4365)) ([#4367](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4367)) by @gaborbernat. - Compare interpreter implementation names without regard to case when validating `base_python` against environment names ([#4369](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4369)) by @mayankdhingra02 and @gaborbernat. - Accept `--config-settings` (`-C`) on requirement lines in requirements files, which pip supports, instead of failing with `unrecognized arguments`; it is still rejected when written in `deps` directly, like `--hash` ([#4366](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4366)) by @mmporong and @gaborbernat. ### New Contributors - @mmporong made their first contribution in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4366 - @mayankdhingra02 made their first contribution in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4369 [PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.67.6/) [Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.67.5...4.67.6)

name: v4.67.5
body: ### Bug fixes - A packaging environment whose `base_python` (or `default_base_python`) is not installed no longer crashes with `KeyError: 'skip_missing_interpreters'`. It now fails with the missing interpreter, or skips the run environment when `skip_missing_interpreters` is true, as tox did before 4.36.0 ([#4213](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4213)) by @gaborbernat. ([#4212](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4212)) - Keep environment markers when a package extra refers to another extra of the same package. For example, `demo[dev]; python_version < '3.10'` keeps the version condition on dependencies from `dev` ([#4216](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4216)) by @ericdelorefice and @gaborbernat. - A `pylock.toml` or a tox user configuration file (`TOX_USER_CONFIG_FILE`) saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark, as some Windows editors do, is now read instead of failing with a TOML decode error or being ignored with `failed to read config file` ([#4217](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4217)) by @pcbeingused333. - With `args_are_paths` enabled, a positional argument naming an existing file whose rewritten path relative to `change_dir` starts with `-` (for example `tests/--config=evil.cfg`) is now prefixed with `./` so the command still receives a path instead of an option ([#4317](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4317)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4218](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4218)) - An extending TOML `replace` table with a nonempty `marker` now raises an error instead of adding its internal `value` and `marker` keys to `deps` or `requires`. Markers on `set_env` values remain supported ([#4320](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4320)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4220](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4220)) - A TOML type mismatch no longer includes an expanded string or container value. A malformed `commands` setting with `{env:...}` reports its type instead of the substituted text ([#4327](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4327)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4221](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4221)) - Keep artifacts supplied with `--installpkg` out of tox's provisioning environment while installing them in the requested test environments ([#4304](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4304)) by @Pratham2511 and @gaborbernat. ([#4222](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4222)) - A `file:` URI passed to `--installpkg` is now percent-decoded once instead of twice, so a path containing a literal `%` sequence, such as a directory named `feature%2Flogin`, selects the package the user named ([#4300](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4300)) by @pcbeingused333 and @gaborbernat. ([#4223](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4223)) - A relative `TOX_INSTALL_PKG` or user configuration `install_pkg` path is now resolved against the invocation directory, as `--installpkg` already was, so tox inspects and installs from the same path ([#4333](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4333)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4224](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4224)) - tox refuses a symlink or Windows junction at `meta_dir` because the build frontend empties that directory during metadata preparation ([#4332](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4332)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4225](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4225)) - An explicitly empty `base_python` (for example `{env:TOXPYTHON:python3.11}` with `TOXPYTHON` empty) now fails during configuration with `base_python for env is empty`. Blank entries in a `base_python` list are ignored ([#4326](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4326)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4226](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4226)) - A path setting that expands to an empty value, such as `env_tmp_dir = {env:SCRATCH_DIR}` with `SCRATCH_DIR` unset, now fails with a configuration error instead of resolving to the current directory, which tox could then clear ([#4330](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4330)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4227](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4227)) - Keep every value of a multi-value command line flag, such as `-f py legacy`, with that flag. The command scanner took a later value matching a subcommand as the command, causing environments without that factor to run ([#4319](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4319)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4228](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4228)) - Unreadable wheels, invalid wheel metadata, and unreadable or empty source archives supplied through `--installpkg` now produce errors that name the artifact instead of internal error tracebacks ([#4287](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4287)) by @santhiprakash and @gaborbernat. ([#4230](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4230)) - Reject NUL characters in `set_env` file assignments with a handled input error instead of a subprocess traceback ([#4279](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4279)) by @Doomguy-BFG9000 and @gaborbernat. ([#4231](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4231)) - Limit each requirement or constraint file to 10 MiB, so oversized and endless includes fail with a size error. For remote files, tox checks a 120-second deadline between response body reads. Slow HTTP framing can delay that check ([#4312](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4312)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4232](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4232)) - tox now validates inline script `dependencies` as requirements before installing them. An invalid entry such as a pip option fails before tox passes the dependencies to pip ([#4306](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4306)) by @santhiprakash and @gaborbernat. ([#4233](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4233)) - Read static package dependencies and the `editable-legacy` install path from the packaging environment's `package_root` instead of the core one, so a `package_root` set in `[testenv:.pkg]` no longer pairs the built package with the dependencies declared next to `tox.ini` ([#4321](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4321)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4234](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4234)) - A package environment path that is already a symlink no longer causes `tox list` to create `file.lock` under the link target ([#4311](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4311)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4235](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4235)) - tox now expands `${VAR}` in requirements and constraints files using the environment running pip, including `pass_env` and `set_env`, instead of the tox process. A variable absent from that environment stays literal, so tox cannot put its host value in a fetched URL. To retain expansion, add it to `pass_env` or define it with `set_env` ([#4323](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4323)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4236](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4236)) - Mask values when a flag or environment variable name contains a secret keyword after a newline ([#4259](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4259)) by @haigou-web and @gaborbernat. ([#4237](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4237)) - `tox -h` no longer prints secret-looking `--key=value` values from `TOX_OVERRIDE`. Conversion warnings also mask those values in invalid `TOX_` options ([#4303](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4303)) by @faresrafat3 and @gaborbernat. ([#4238](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4238)) - A `tox.toml` or `pyproject.toml` string with literal braces around text containing a colon, such as a JSON argument holding a URL or a time, is now kept as written, as in `tox.ini`, instead of being read as a `{key:default}` reference. Positional arguments such as `set_env:x` passed into such braces through `{posargs}` no longer expand into the value of that setting ([#4269](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4269)) by @Anandb71 and @gaborbernat. ([#4239](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4239)) - Reject wheel metadata entries over 8 MiB uncompressed, limiting memory use during package installation ([#4328](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4328)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4240](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4240)) - Recreate an environment when its `.tox-info.json` contains a non-mapping value for a section that requires a mapping ([#4258](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4258)) by @haigou-web and @gaborbernat. ([#4241](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4241)) - Preserve empty positional arguments when rewriting relative paths for `change_dir` ([#4256](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4256)) by @Fire162 and @gaborbernat. ([#4242](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4242)) - `base_python_file` rejects non-regular files, undecodable content, and version lines over 1024 characters with a handled error naming the file. It reads comments in bounded chunks, so a long comment can still precede the version ([#4325](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4325)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4243](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4243)) - `base_python_file` now accepts only a Python version specifier (such as `3.13` or `pypy3.10`) from the version file. A path or program name there no longer makes tox start that program during interpreter discovery, and the rejected line is not echoed in the error message ([#4324](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4324)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4244](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4244)) - An inline `deps` or `constraints` entry that directly substitutes a host variable via `{env:NAME}` or a TOML `replace = "env"` table now passes `${OTHER}` text in that value to pip unchanged. A TOML reference to the loaded entry keeps the same behavior. A `${NAME}` reference written in the configuration or a substitution default still expands ([#4329](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4329)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4245](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4245)) - `pylock` now evaluates Python and platform markers using a complete environment from the target interpreter. Previously, missing values such as `implementation_version` came from the Python running tox, which could select a package locked for the wrong interpreter ([#4331](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4331)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4246](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4246)) - For active packages in a `pylock.toml`, reject whitespace or control characters in hash tokens, archive or VCS URLs, commit IDs, and subdirectories before writing pip requirements. A line break in one of these fields could add a pip option such as `--index-url`. The check also covers values pip expands from `${VAR}` references. Changing a referenced value reinstalls the locked packages ([#4315](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4315)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4247](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4247)) - A direct URL entry in `requires` (such as `tox @ file:///path/to/tox.whl`) now triggers provisioning unless the installed distribution's `direct_url.json` records the requested source, including a supported archive hash, subdirectory, or VCS revision. [pip](https://pip.pypa.io/en/stable/) discards fragment fields such as `egg`; these no longer trigger repeat provisioning. When the installer omits credentials from the origin record, a credentialed direct URL without a requested archive hash fails with an explanation instead of hanging during provisioning ([#4314](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4314)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4248](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4248)) - tox now rejects sdist members whose paths or link targets escape the extraction directory. On Python versions without the `tarfile` data filter, tox checks each member as it extracts the archive ([#4316](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4316)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4249](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4249)) - Report the file and line number for an invalid `set_env` file line, since its content may contain a secret ([#4298](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4298)) by @r3wretrhy and @gaborbernat. ([#4250](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4250)) - Keep input bytes out of `tox config` INI, JSON, and TOML output when a configuration key reads non-UTF-8 data ([#4302](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4302)) by @ducanhnguyen223, ducanhnguyen223 and @gaborbernat. ([#4251](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4251)) - A pre-existing symlink at `.tox-info.json` no longer supplies cached state. When tox writes state, it replaces the link and leaves its target untouched ([#4322](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4322)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4253](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4253)) - When rebuilding a stale bootstrap environment for `virtualenv_spec`, tox removes a link at the cache path and creates the replacement without `venv`'s `clear` option. A link placed there after cleanup and before directory creation stops the rebuild without emptying its target ([#4313](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4313)) by @rahuldevikar and @gaborbernat. ([#4254](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4254)) - Redirected Windows output now escapes characters its code page cannot encode instead of raising `UnicodeEncodeError`. The stream keeps its encoding ([#4257](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4257)) by @haigou-web and @gaborbernat. ([#4255](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4255)) - Read the Docs now fetches Git history and tags before installing tox, so VCS version detection can satisfy `tox-uv` ([#4337](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4337)) by @gaborbernat. ([#4336](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4336)) - A host variable substituted through `set_env` into `deps` or `constraints` now keeps `${NAME}` text literal for pip. A `${NAME}` written in the configuration still expands ([#4342](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4342)) by @gaborbernat. ([#4338](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4338)) - On Windows, building a `virtualenv_spec` bootstrap environment no longer writes through a junction swapped into its cache entry. A linked project work directory still works; the work directory must allow temporary subdirectories ([#4341](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4341)) by @gaborbernat. ([#4339](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4339)) - `test_parallel_general` uses an absolute missing-interpreter path to avoid Windows registry probes in CI ([#4346](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4346)) by @gaborbernat. ([#4344](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4344)) - A `set_env` line with a substituted key keeps its value in one variable, even when the input contains a line break. A key that expands to `=` or a line separator raises an error ([#4265](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4265)) by @gaborbernat. - A host environment value selected by `{env:NAME}` that references itself twice could stall tox during recursive expansion. tox now stops expansion at the first depth-limit hit, logs one warning, and leaves the remaining text unexpanded ([#4272](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4272)) by @gaborbernat. - An included `set_env` keeps `{env:...}` values intact when the source environment inherits the setting, uses `setenv` or comes from a generative section. The TOML string form `"{[env.name]set_env}"` does the same. Line breaks, `;` and `file|` text inside values no longer become `set_env` syntax ([#4268](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4268)) by @gaborbernat. - An invalid `pylock.toml`, including malformed TOML or non-UTF-8 bytes, now reports `invalid pylock file` with the filename and the parser or decoder error instead of an internal traceback ([#4215](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4215)) by @PRINCE2-AI, Prince and @gaborbernat. - Help with an invalid `-c` configuration now looks for an inline plugin in the requested file's parent directory or inside the selected directory ([#4267](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4267)) by @gaborbernat. - INI commands now keep a path reference such as `{tox_root}`, `{env_tmp_dir}` or `{env_python}` within one argument, including when the path contains spaces, quotes or backslashes. The same applies to tox-provided values such as `{host_python}` and `{tox_root_name}`, entries of a list such as `{base_python}`, and file names matched by `{glob:PATTERN}`. Command values set with `-x` or `TOX_OVERRIDE` follow the same rule ([#4290](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4290)) by @gaborbernat. - INI commands that reference `deps` now preserve each pip option operand as one argument. A substituted `--find-links` path containing spaces can no longer add options to the command. The `tox config` display escapes spaces, quotes and backslashes in those operands ([#4276](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4276)) by @gaborbernat. - Keep a substitution within the quoted INI command argument it is part of: `"--title={env:TITLE}"` is one argument even when the value of `TITLE` holds quotes or whitespace, as it is for a TOML argument array. tox used to paste the value into the command text before splitting it, so a quote in the value ended the argument and the rest of the value arrived as further arguments of the command. `install_command` and `list_dependencies_command` get the same handling ([#4283](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4283)) by @gaborbernat. - Mask credentials in `requires` direct URLs in missing-requirement messages and echoed provisioning commands ([#4334](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4334)) by @gaborbernat. - Mask secret-looking inline flag values in result JSON command lists, retry warnings, subprocess start errors, path debug logs, unknown-argument errors, and `ExecuteRequest` representations ([#4264](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4264)) by @gaborbernat. - On POSIX, tox now pins each directory on the path to the project root while reading or changing a `.venv` redirect. A concurrent path swap can no longer redirect removal or replacement into another directory ([#4308](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4308)) by @gaborbernat. - On POSIX, tox now resolves relative commands and `PATH` entries from the command's working directory. The `allowlist_externals` check and `TOX_LIMITED_SHEBANG` interpreter selection use the file that the child executes ([#4275](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4275)) by @gaborbernat. - On Windows, INI command references such as `{[testenv:a]commands}` now preserve argument boundaries when a positional argument contains an apostrophe or backslash. `tox config` displays the command with the same quoting tox uses to parse a reference ([#4277](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4277)) by @gaborbernat. - On Windows, tox pins the project path while reading or changing a `.venv` redirect. A concurrent directory rename or junction added to an empty project directory cannot redirect a write or removal into another project. Redirect writes replace `.venv` with a temporary file, leaving the target of a swapped `.venv` symlink or hard link unchanged ([#4335](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4335)) by @gaborbernat. - On Windows, tox quotes arguments passed to `.bat` and `.cmd` commands for `cmd.exe`. Values containing shell operators or percent signs reach the batch file without starting another command or expanding environment variables. Batch scripts that inspect raw `%1` may now see surrounding quotes for arguments that need them ([#4288](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4288)) by @gaborbernat. - Pass each `base_python` entry to virtualenv as a separate `--python` argument. virtualenv split the old `VIRTUALENV_PYTHON` value on commas and `os.pathsep`, then tried the first candidate last; that could start an unintended program ([#4292](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4292)) by @gaborbernat. - Prefix normalized dependency paths whose first component starts with `-` using `./` on POSIX or `.\` on Windows. The resulting pip argument no longer starts with `-` ([#4266](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4266)) by @gaborbernat. - Preserve `#` in INI references to paths, so `change_dir`, `env_dir` and `set_env = file|...` use the checkout directory when its name contains `#`. On POSIX, requirement-file paths with a space before `#` remain readable ([#4285](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4285)) by @gaborbernat. - Preserve frozen dependency constraints when using `--no-capture` or setting up an environment with `tox exec` ([#4301](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4301)) by @Pratham2511 and @gaborbernat. - Reject a bootstrap cache parent that already resolves outside the work directory before opening its lock or creating an environment ([#4345](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4345)) by @gaborbernat. - Reject a line break in a substitution within one `deps` or `constraints` entry, and a backslash ending a substituted requirement line. Also reject line breaks and trailing backslashes in globbed requirement paths and provisioning requirements. These values can no longer add pip options or consume the following entry ([#4295](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4295)) by @gaborbernat. - Reject an entry separator supplied by a substitution within an INI list, set, dictionary or `env_list` entry. This prevents a value inside one `requires` entry from adding a requirement, and a value inside one `env_list` entry from selecting another environment. A substitution that occupies a whole entry can still expand to several entries. The same check applies to text overrides supplied with `-x` or `TOX_OVERRIDE` ([#4284](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4284)) by @gaborbernat. - Replace line breaks in positional arguments before quoting them for `{posargs}` and INI command references. This prevents a line break in one argument from starting another command ([#4294](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4294)) by @gaborbernat. - Shell completion now uses the `-c`/`--conf` path from the typed line when loading `toxfile.py` and offering environments. While that path is incomplete, completion loads no inline plugin ([#4278](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4278)) by @gaborbernat. - The provisioned tox now starts with Python's safe path option. During its `-m tox` re-exec, Python no longer puts the start directory first on `sys.path`, where an unrelated file could replace tox or a dependency ([#4270](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4270)) by @gaborbernat. - Validate built-in command options before selecting an inline plugin. An invalid option value no longer causes tox to import a plugin from an unselected project. Put `-c`/`--conf` or `--root` before options defined by an inline plugin ([#4281](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4281)) by @gaborbernat. - Values expanded from secret-named environment variables in requirements files no longer appear in the install cache, recreation warnings, or file-read errors. tox may recreate an existing environment once to replace a cache written by an older version ([#4280](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4280)) by @gaborbernat. - When positional arguments supply the command, as in `tox exec` or `commands = {posargs}`, tox now leaves a bare program name such as `python` unchanged. It also leaves a bare executable first positional value unchanged, including when a command uses that value as data, because wrappers can run it as a program. A same-named file in the start directory no longer replaces the environment's program. An explicit path such as `./python` still follows `args_are_paths` ([#4289](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4289)) by @gaborbernat. - With `TOX_LIMITED_SHEBANG` enabled, tox now keeps quote and backslash characters in an unquoted shebang interpreter path. They no longer change the executable tox starts. The existing double-quoted form for paths with spaces remains supported ([#4274](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4274)) by @gaborbernat. - With `args_are_paths` on POSIX, tox now rewrites positional paths from the resolved `change_dir`. A linked `.tox` can no longer redirect a positional path to a file beside the link target ([#4273](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4273)) by @gaborbernat. - `pylock` and `dependency_groups` now use `package_root` when a run has no package environment. They previously used `tox_root` in that case ([#4299](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4299)) by @pcbeingused333 and @gaborbernat. - tox now rejects environment names that are not a single path component before creating an environment. This prevents a substituted `env_list`, label or package environment name from selecting a directory outside `work_dir` ([#4271](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4271)) by @gaborbernat. - tox now resolves relative `env_dir`, `env_tmp_dir`, `env_log_dir`, `work_dir`, `temp_dir`, `package_root`, `meta_dir`, `pkg_dir` and `package_glob` values against `tox_root`. With `tox -c path/to/tox.ini` started elsewhere, it no longer clears or reuses those directories in the start directory or selects a package from there ([#4291](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4291)) by @gaborbernat. - tox passes positional arguments, `{glob:PATTERN}` matches and `TOX_FACTOR_

name: v4.67.3
body: ### Bug fixes - An open-ended factor range whose explicit bound sits outside the supported CPython window no longer expands to nothing. An INI `env_list` such as `py3{16-}` used to fail with `ValueError: py3{}`, and a TOML range dict expanded to an empty axis, dropping that dimension from the matrix ([#4176](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4176)) by @HyperionBurn and @gaborbernat. - A TOML `replace = "glob"` table now substitutes its `pattern` and `default`, matching the INI `{glob:PATTERN:DEFAULT}` form, so `pattern = "{env_name}/*.whl"` matches files instead of a literal `{env_name}` directory ([#4180](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4180)) by @ag3ntsc4rn and @gaborbernat. ([#4178](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4178)) - `--force-dep` now matches dependency names after [PEP 503](https://peps.python.org/pep-0503/) normalization, so `--force-dep typing-extensions==4.9.0` replaces `Typing_Extensions==4.12.2` in `deps` instead of passing both pins to pip, and replaces a `Typing_Extensions` requirement from the package metadata, where tox used to drop the forced pin ([#4181](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4181)) by @ag3ntsc4rn and @gaborbernat. ([#4179](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4179)) - `{glob:PATTERN:DEFAULT}` with a single-letter pattern and an absolute default, such as `{glob:z:/fallback}`, no longer expands to an empty string on POSIX: tox now looks for a Windows drive letter in the pattern only on Windows ([#4183](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4183)) by @JingHao-Leon and @gaborbernat. ([#4182](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4182)) - A TOML `{ replace = "env" }` table in `set_env` whose `default` ends in a backslash now resolves to the variable or the default, instead of the literal `{env:...}` text ([#4185](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4185)) by @JingHao-Leon and @gaborbernat. ([#4184](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4184)) - `--no-index` in a requirements file or `deps` now wins over `--index-url` and `--extra-index-url` on the same or a later line, as in pip. Previously tox dropped it and installed from those indexes, and from PyPI too when given an `--extra-index-url` ([#4187](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4187)) by @syahra712 and @gaborbernat. - A leading UTF-8 byte order mark in `pyproject.toml` no longer breaks `dependency_groups` or reading the package's static dependencies from `[project]`, and one in a `base_python_file` such as `.python-version` is no longer read as part of the Python version ([#4188](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4188)) by @pcbeingused333 and @gaborbernat. - `--parallel auto` now counts the CPUs tox may run on instead of every CPU in the machine, so it respects the CPU affinity mask set by `taskset` or a container's cpuset (and `PYTHON_CPU_COUNT` on Python 3.13+) ([#4190](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4190)) by @mehdimirzafaruk and @gaborbernat. - A TOML `{ replace = "ref", env = ..., key = ... }` now takes a path (`change_dir`, `env_dir`), set (`extras`, `labels`, `dependency_groups`) or environment list (`depends`) value from another environment, instead of failing validation of the referencing key ([#4192](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4192)) by @pcbeingused333 and @gaborbernat. - `--result-json` is now always written as UTF-8 instead of the locale's preferred encoding. Captured output that a legacy Windows code page cannot represent, or that holds bytes which are not valid UTF-8, no longer crashes the run at the end with a truncated file; the invalid bytes are stored as `\uXXXX` escapes ([#4194](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4194)) by @mehdimirzafaruk and @gaborbernat. - Glob character sets such as `lint-[ab]` and `lint-[!a]` in an ini `depends` now load, as the `depends` reference documents, instead of failing to load the configuration ([#4195](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4195)) by @nk-batman21 and @gaborbernat. - Disable the parallel spinner by default in CI for the legacy command, as `tox run-parallel` does ([#4196](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4196)) by @Rodrigo-Palma and @gaborbernat. - Leave extras, editables, local directories and source archives out of the `constrain_package_deps` constraints file, so pip no longer rejects it ([#4203](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4203)) by @ericdelorefice and @gaborbernat. - An empty `PYTHONHASHSEED` no longer makes every tox command fail with `ValueError`. tox treats it as unset, as Python does, and picks a random seed ([#4205](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4205)) by @devYRPauli and @gaborbernat. ### Documentation - Explain how to quote command arguments built from `[vars]` values that contain spaces, and how quotes stored in those values pair with the quotes around them ([#4197](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4197)) by @Blues-berry and @gaborbernat. ([#4191](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4191)) ### New Contributors - @devYRPauli made their first contribution in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4205 - @JingHao-Leon made their first contribution in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4183 - @HyperionBurn made their first contribution in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4176 - @ag3ntsc4rn made their first contribution in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4180 - @ericdelorefice made their first contribution in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4203 - @nk-batman21 made their first contribution in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4195 - @mehdimirzafaruk made their first contribution in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4194 - @Blues-berry made their first contribution in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4197 [PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.67.3/) [Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.67.2...4.67.3)

name: v4.64.8
body: ### Bug fixes - tox combines `--no-binary` and `--only-binary` across the lines of `deps` and of requirements files the way pip does, where the last line used to replace the earlier ones. With `--only-binary :all:` and a `--no-binary` exception, tox passes `--only-binary` to pip first, so pip keeps the exception. `tox config` shows the merged values tox passes to pip by [@SulimanAbdulrazzaq](https://github.com/SulimanAbdulrazzaq). ([#4110](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4110)) - `tox config` shows `deps` with every global option merged the way tox passes it to pip, a later `-i` replacing an earlier one and repeated flags shown once, and reports the error `tox run` would raise for invalid `deps`. `constraints` shows the configured files instead of the path of `tox.ini`, and a comment line in `constraints` no longer fails the run. `deps` that give pip nothing to install no longer conflict with `pylock`. `set_env` includes `PIP_USER`, `TOX_ENV_DIR`, `TOX_ENV_NAME`, `TOX_WORK_DIR` and `VIRTUAL_ENV`, the values tox sets for commands by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#4111](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4111)) - A TOML `ref` to another environment's `deps`, `constraints` or `commands` works in `tox config` and `tox run`. It used to fail with `'PythonDeps' object is not iterable` or `Command(args=[...]) is not list` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#4112](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4112)) - In INI `commands`, `commands_pre` and `commands_post`, a reference such as `pip install {[testenv:x]deps}` that shares its line with other text joins the referenced lines into that one command as arguments, as in tox 3. tox used to run each referenced line after the first as a separate command. A reference alone on its line still expands to one command per referenced line. This changes `echo {[testenv:x]commands}`, which now runs one `echo` with every referenced command as its arguments by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#4113](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4113)) - The JSON schema described `requires` with the text of `provision_tox_env`, so editors showed the wrong hover for it by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#4115](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4115)) ### Documentation - The configuration reference listed wrong defaults for `args_are_paths` (`True`), `pkg_dir` (`{env_dir}/dist`), `skip_missing_interpreters` (`False`), `min_version` (unset) and `requires` (`tox`) by [@Rodrigo-Palma](https://github.com/Rodrigo-Palma). name: v4.64.6
body: ### Bug fixes - `tox -e` and `TOXENV` accept every interpreter name that picks a `base_python` for an environment the configuration does not declare by [@breken-ai](https://github.com/breken-ai). - `cpython313`, `cpython-3.13`, `graalpy311`, `jython2.7`, `rustpython3` and `ironpython3` select that interpreter instead of failing with "provided environments not found". - The `d` debug-build suffix works too, for example `py313d`. - `cython313` now fails as an unknown environment; it used to run on the Python that tox runs under. ([#4106](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4106)) - A `set_env` block pulled in with `{[section]set_env}` now applies a PEP-508 marker only to the value it came with, as the inline and TOML forms already do by [@feiiiiii5](https://github.com/feiiiiii5). A false marker on an earlier line no longer hides a value that the inheriting environment, a later unconditional line or an environment file supplies. ([#4107](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4107)) - `set_env` values resolve when tox reads them, so `{env:KEY}` sees the keys a block pulls in with `{[section]set_env}`, and a `{ replace = "env" }` table sees the keys next to it by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat), found by [@breken-ai](https://github.com/breken-ai). Configurations that see a difference: - A value pulled in from another section that refers to a key of the same block now gets the block's value instead of the host variable. - A pulled-in line that refers to its own key, such as `PYTHONHASHSEED = {env:PYTHONHASHSEED:0}`, reads the host variable or its default, as the same line written in place does. It used to read the value tox sets. - A key written in an INI `set_env` wins over the same key pulled in from another section, and a later pulled-in section wins over an earlier one, at every nesting level. A nested section could override the section that included it before. - `tox config` shows the keys of every pulled-in section that `tox run` sets. - A section that pulls itself in, a TOML `ref` to itself, and values that refer to each other fail the environment with the cycle. They used to fail with a traceback or "could not find python interpreter", and values that referred to each other inside a pulled-in section read the host variables without a warning. ([#4108](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4108)) ### New Contributors - [@breken-ai](https://github.com/breken-ai) made their first contribution in [#4106](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4106) - [@feiiiiii5](https://github.com/feiiiiii5) made their first contribution in [#4107](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/4107) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.64.6/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.64.5...4.64.6)

body: ### Bug fixes - A `set_env` written as a list of tables in TOML now keeps every `file` entry and honors the order of the entries, so merging one environment's `set_env` into another no longer drops the environment file it referenced ([#4093](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4093)) by [@Rodrigo-Palma](https://github.com/Rodrigo-Palma). - Each `{ file = "..." }` entry is read; previously only the last one survived, because the entries were merged into a single table first and a table cannot hold the key twice. - A variable set after a `file` entry wins over the value the file provides, matching the `file|` form in INI; previously a repeated variable was pulled back to its first position, letting the file override it. - A later entry that sets a variable without a marker clears the marker an earlier entry gave it, again matching the INI form. ([#4093](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4093)) - Create the package build environment `change_dir` directory before running the build commands, as the documentation already promises. name: v4.57.2
body: ### Bug fixes - Fix package environment creation failures being misreported: - discard the partially registered configuration on failure, so the real error surfaces instead of a spurious `duplicate configuration definition`; - report the first creation failure in definition order, not a hash-random one; - build the PEP 517 frontend lazily, so `tox c` and `tox l` work when `pyproject.toml` cannot be read. ([#3987](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3987)) - Fix state corruption in the environment creation machinery: - a failed run environment build no longer removes shared package environments other run environments still use; - a run environment registers with its package environment once, not twice with triple-counted usage; - circular `depends` reports the cycle as an error instead of a raw traceback; - `Skip` raised by a plugin for a package environment marks the run environment package-skipped instead of crashing with `UnboundLocalError`. ([#3991](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3991)) - Fix two packaging regressions: - `package = editable` on a build backend without PEP-660 support now falls back to `editable-legacy` with a warning instead of crashing, also when the project metadata is static; - editable and wheel environments running after an `sdist-wheel` environment build from the project sources again, instead of a stale temporary copy that made source edits invisible. ([#3992](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3992)) - An environment serving as both a run environment and a package environment now behaves predictably: - one defined through a `[testenv:...]`-style section and referenced by `package_env` inherits from `pkgenv`/`env_pkg_base` as documented, instead of silently keeping run environment defaults; - one listed in `env_list` while referenced as a package environment is reported as a configuration conflict up front, instead of failing late with `cannot run packaging environment` or silently disappearing from `tox l`. ([#3993](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3993)) - `pylock.toml` installs now match the lock file: - a package locked once per Python range installs only the version matching the environment's interpreter; - packages locked to a local directory, VCS repository, or archive install from that source instead of resolving the name against the package index; - locked hashes are verified when every entry carries one; - changing a pip environment variable such as `PIP_INDEX_URL` reinstalls, as it already did for `deps`. ([#3994](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3994)) - Re-running tox no longer rebuilds an environment at random when `deps` uses `--no-binary` or `--only-binary` with more than one package name. ([#3995](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3995)) - A corrupted environment status file (`.tox-info.json`) now always triggers an environment recreation instead of crashing tox with an internal error for some corruption shapes. ([#3996](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3996)) - PEP 723 scripts saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark now have their inline metadata honored (previously `requires-python` and `dependencies` were silently ignored), and a script with invalid metadata reports a clear configuration error instead of an internal one. ([#3997](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3997)) - Fix three command line defects: - `tox c -o FILE` writes the default (ini) format to the file like the json and toml formats, without color codes; - `tox devenv -e ALL` reports that exactly one environment is required instead of crashing; - `--no-provision FILE` records the pinned version for a `tox==X` requirement instead of an empty string. ([#3998](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3998)) - Restore the documented fail-fast contract and make cleanup resilient: - `--fail-fast` in parallel mode lets already running environments finish and report their real outcomes, instead of interrupting them after a second and mislabeling them as skipped; - environments canceled by fail fast before starting report as skipped; - the overall exit code under fail fast is the first failed environment's exit code, as documented; - one environment failing to clean up no longer prevents the remaining environments from cleaning up (which could leave tox hanging on exit). ([#3999](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3999)) - Polish four behaviors around the edges of a run: - an empty `[tool.tox]` stub in `pyproject.toml` no longer hides a `tox.toml` next to it; - setting `CI=false` (or empty) is respected as opting out of CI behavior; - spinner animation frames stay out of redirected output, which now holds plain text only; - the JSON report marks skipped environments with `"skipped": true` so they are distinguishable from passes. ([#4000](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/4000)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.57.2/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.57.1...4.57.2)

name: v4.56.2
body: ### Bug fixes - Fix a batch of latent defects found in a codebase audit: - stop duplicating `--extra-index-url` when a merged requirements line repeats an already-seen index; - render `--no-binary`/`--only-binary` as comma-joined strings instead of leaking the internal `set` into the pip command line; - report a clear error instead of `IndexError` for a bare one-argument flag (`-c`, `-r`, `-f`, `-e`) in `deps` or constraints; - canonicalize `optional-dependencies` keys and self-referential (recursive) extra names so non-canonical spellings no longer silently drop dependencies; - raise a clear error instead of `KeyError` when `dependency_groups` is requested without a `[dependency-groups]` table; - stop a native TOML `{ replace = "env" }` reference from leaking its resolution chain into sibling list entries and tripping a spurious `circular chain` error; - expand the range that actually matched in a factor expression rather than the first identical digit-range substring; - strip the backslash from an escaped `\;` in `set_env` values; - skip option values during command auto-detection so an environment named like a subcommand (e.g. `tox -e list`) is no longer misread; - treat an empty list-typed environment variable (e.g. `TOX_DISCOVER=`) as an empty list rather than `[""]`; - report an environment whose name is an empty string as present in `Config` membership tests; - fail evaluation gracefully instead of crashing the driver thread when `tox p -p all` is run with an empty selection; - avoid rebuilding a throwaway PEP 517 frontend against the previous root when a package environment's `root` is reassigned before a frontend exists; - avoid crashing `create_session_view` when the package and its session copy share no common path (e.g. different Windows drives); - close the pseudo-terminal file descriptors that leaked on every command run under a tty and on the terminal-attribute inheritance error path; - honor the stop signal in the Windows overlapped-I/O reader while a read is still pending, so shutdown no longer risks hanging on a child that holds its pipe open without producing output. ([#3974](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3974)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.56.2/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.56.1...4.56.2)

name: v4.56.1
body: ### Bug fixes - Fix `{ replace = "if" ... extend = true }` corrupting the resulting list when `then` or `else` is a scalar string (e.g. `then = "-v"`): a non-empty scalar string is now appended as a single element instead of being iterated character-by-character, while a false `if` with no `else` (yielding `""`) contributes nothing rather than an empty element, and list/set results are still spread into the parent. ([#3969](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3969)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.56.1/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.56.0...4.56.1)

name: v4.56.0
body: ### Features - Derive `virtualenv_spec` automatically: when an environment targets a Python version the installed `virtualenv` can no longer create (e.g. `py38` with virtualenv `21.5+`), tox now pins the newest virtualenv that still supports it and bootstraps it for that environment only. The downgrade happens only when every `base_python` candidate is unsupported, so environments targeting current interpreters are unaffected. This fixes `py38` (and other end-of-life interpreters) being silently skipped after a virtualenv upgrade by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3965](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3965)) ([#3965](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3965)) ### Bug fixes - The default value of `skip_missing_interpreters` changed from `True` to `False` — missing interpreters now fail the run by default, matching tox 3 behavior. The tox 4 rewrite unintentionally changed this default. To restore the previous (incorrect) behavior, set `skip_missing_interpreters = true` in your tox configuration or pass `--skip-missing-interpreters` on the command line. ([#3965](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3965)) ### Documentation - Fix nested list items being rendered with continued numbering instead of as sub-items in `development.rst`, `onboarding.rst` and `explanation.rst`. ([#3960](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3960)) - Replace stale `http://tox.readthedocs.org` URL with `https://tox.wiki` in `pyproject.toml` (`Homepage`), `.github/CONTRIBUTING.md`, and `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`. ([#3963](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3963)) ### New Contributors - [@TejasAmle](https://github.com/TejasAmle) made their first contribution in [#3963](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3963) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.56.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.55.1...4.56.0)

Previously, overriding a base value that was later referenced via `{[section]key}` (ini) or `{replace = "ref", of = [...]}` (toml) was ignored because reference resolution read the raw file value, bypassing the override system by [@tales-aparecida](https://github.com/tales-aparecida). This variable is used by Ghostty to communicate terminal capabilities to programs. Previously, both the user-provided constraints file and the auto-generated constraints file were passed to pip during `install_package_deps`, which could cause resolver conflicts when the same package appeared in both files by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). A guard test asserts the schema stays in sync with the loader implementation so future replace types cannot be added without a corresponding schema entry. name: v4.53.1
body: ### Bug fixes - Hardening pass on user-facing logging and config parsing: - Mask secret-looking `--key=value` flag values in command logs (terminal warnings, `.tox//log/*.log`, and `Outcome` `__repr__`) using the same keyword regex previously applied to environment variable values. - Resolve PEP 723 `script` paths and reject any that escape `tox_root`; cap the script read at 5 MiB so a symlink to `/dev/zero` cannot exhaust memory. - Replace `eval()` of a constructed `Literal[...]` string in the CLI parser with a direct `Literal[tuple(action.choices)]` subscript. - Pass `timeout=30` to `urlopen` when fetching a remote requirements file so a slow or unresponsive mirror cannot hang `tox` indefinitely. ([#3924](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3924)) - Allow the generated TOML schema to validate array values for `deps`. ([#3929](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3929)) - Correct type annotations for `ArgumentParser.parse_args` and `parse_known_args` overrides following [typeshed PR #15613](https://github.com/python/typeshed/pull/15613), which widened the `args` parameter from `Sequence[str]` to `Iterable[str]`. The narrower type in tox's overrides violated the Liskov substitution principle and caused `invalid-method-override` errors with `ty` 0.0.33. Also correct the `option_spec` annotation in `docs/tox_conf.py` to `ClassVar[dict[str, Callable[[str], Any]]]` matching the docutils stubs type. ([#3932](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3932)) ### New Contributors - [@cyphercodes](https://github.com/cyphercodes) made their first contribution in [#3931](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3931) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.53.1/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.53.0...4.53.1)

body: ### Bug fixes - `ignore_base_python_conflict` now also suppresses errors when an environment name contains multiple conflicting version-like factors (e.g., `unit-py3.10-2.16` where both `py3.10` and `2.16` are detected as Python versions). Previously this flag only handled conflicts between explicit `base_python` settings and the environment name by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3847](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3847)) ### New Contributors - [@yarikoptic](https://github.com/yarikoptic) made their first contribution in [#3847](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3847) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.47.2/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.47.1...4.47.2)

name: v4.47.0
body: ### Features - Show clean error messages instead of stack traces when TOML configuration contains type mismatches (e.g., `deps = [1]`), wrapping failures in `HandledError` with environment and key context by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3831](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3831)) - Add comprehensive tests asserting full error messages for every configurable field type when TOML config contains type mismatches by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3840](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3840)) ### Bug fixes - Fix type errors flagged by `ty` for `virtualenv` API changes (`system_executable` nullability and `cached_py_info.PythonInfo` removal), and correct the CI workflow matrix exclude for `windows-2025` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3837](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3837)) - `base_python` and `default_base_python` now accept a string value in TOML configuration (e.g., `base_python = "python"` is coerced to `["python"]`) instead of raising `TypeError` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3839](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3839)) - Pass stdin through to commands executed via `tox exec` so that piped input (e.g., `echo "foo" | tox exec -- python -c 'import sys; print(sys.stdin.read())'`) reaches the subprocess instead of being discarded by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3841](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3841)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.47.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.46.3...4.47.0)
