name: v4.46.0
body: ### Features - Add architecture (ISA) awareness to Python discovery. tox now propagates the `machine` field (e.g. `arm64`, `x86_64`) from `virtualenv`'s interpreter info — derived from `get_platform` — through the Python specification, validation, and journal. This allows selecting a Python interpreter by CPU architecture via `base_python` (e.g. `cpython3.12-64-arm64`) and ensures tox validates the running interpreter's architecture matches the requested one. Requires `virtualenv >= 20.39` by [@rahuldevikar](https://github.com/rahuldevikar). ([#3069](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3069)) - Add `env_base` TOML sections for named environment templates that generate multiple environments from factor combinations via Cartesian product -- by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3817](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3817)) ### Bug fixes - Drop `chardet` dependency and use BOM detection with locale fallback for requirements file decoding, matching pip's own approach by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3818](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3818)) - Allow `--help` to render even when the configuration file is malformed or missing by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3819](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3819)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.46.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.45.0...4.46.0)

name: v4.45.0
body: ### Features - Enhance `tox schema` command: add `x-taplo` metadata for IDE integration, product dict support for `env_list`, handle `int` and `PythonConstraints` types, fix `$schema` draft-07 URI, and add schema freshness test. Add `tox.toml` to SchemaStore catalog for automatic IDE validation by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1388](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1388)) ### Bug fixes - Add redirects for old documentation URLs that broke after the Diataxis restructure (e.g. `/config.html` -> `/reference/config.html`, `/example/general.html` -> `/index.html`) using `sphinx-reredirects` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3806](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3806)) - Fix cross-section substitution `{[section]key}` resolving to a literal unresolved reference instead of empty string when the referenced value contains only factor-conditional lines and no factors match the requesting environment by [@Fridayai700](https://github.com/Fridayai700). ([#3809](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3809)) - Fix circular dependency in `environment_variables` when `set_env` references `{env_site_packages_dir}` or similar lazy constants, causing `RecursionError` silently caught as "could not find python interpreter" by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3816](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3816)) ### New Contributors - [@cpburnz](https://github.com/cpburnz) made their first contribution in [#3805](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3805) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.45.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.44.0...4.45.0)

name: v4.44.0
body: ### Features - Support PEP 751 `pylock.toml` lock files as dependency input via the `pylock` configuration option (mutually exclusive with `deps`). Packages are filtered by extras, dependency groups, and platform markers evaluated against the target Python interpreter, then installed via pip with `--no-deps` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3665](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3665)) ### Bug fixes - Fix unfactored continuation lines (e.g. `pytest \`, `--remote-data \`) being incorrectly skipped when they follow a filtered factor-conditional line ending with `\` -- the `pending_skip` flag now only drops terminal continuation pieces, preserving shared arguments that are themselves continuations by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3802](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3802)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.44.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.43.0...4.44.0)

name: v4.43.0
body: ### Features - Add TOML-native generative `env_list` via `product` dict syntax -- Cartesian product of factor groups with optional range dicts and exclusions by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3797](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3797)) ### Bug fixes - Pass `config_settings_build_wheel` to pip as `--config-settings` when installing sdist packages, ensuring the build backend receives config settings during pip's internal wheel build by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3125](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3125)) - Fix factor-conditional continuation lines (e.g. `cov: coverage run \` / `!cov: python \` / `somefile.py`) where different factor prefixes on consecutive continuation lines caused prefixes to be passed as literal command arguments instead of being filtered by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3796](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3796)) ### Documentation - Integrate `sphinxcontrib-towncrier` to render draft changelog entries directly in Sphinx, replacing the manual towncrier draft script by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3201](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3201)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.43.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.42.0...4.43.0)

name: v4.42.0
body: ### Features - Platform-dependent commands can now be specified using factor syntax without requiring the platform name in the environment name. The current platform (`sys.platform` value like `linux`, `darwin`, `win32`) is automatically available as an implicit factor, allowing configurations like `linux: pytest` in INI or `factor.linux` in TOML conditional expressions to work in any environment. Additionally, TOML configurations can now use `factor.NAME` in conditional expressions to filter settings based on environment name factors, achieving feature parity with INI's factor system by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2092](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2092)) - Add `{env_site_packages_dir_plat}` / `{envsitepackagesdir_plat}` substitution that returns the platform-specific (platlib) site-packages directory. On some Linux distributions (Fedora, RHEL) this resolves to `lib64` instead of `lib`, which is no longer symlinked since virtualenv 20.x by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2302](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2302)) - External packaging environments (`package = external`) now only run their build commands once per session, reusing the built package for all test environments that depend on them by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2729](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2729)) - Add `default_base_python` configuration key to specify a fallback Python interpreter when no Python factor or explicit `base_python` is defined. This allows projects to pin a default Python version for reproducibility across different machines without conflicting with `pyXY` factor-named environments by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2846](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2846)) - CLI options added by plugins listed in `requires` are now accepted during provisioning instead of failing with "unrecognized arguments" by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2935](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2935)) - Warn about unused configuration keys during `tox run -v` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3188](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3188)) - Improve towncrier changelog structure with more granular categories: `breaking`, `deprecation`, `feature`, `bugfix`, `doc`, `packaging`, `contrib`, and `misc` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3200](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3200)) - Add `--skip-env-install` CLI flag to skip dependency and package installation, allowing reuse of existing environments when offline or when installation is unnecessary by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3310](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3310)) - Add `recreate_commands` configuration option to run cleanup commands (e.g. clearing external caches like pre-commit) before the environment directory is removed during recreation (`-r`) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3423](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3423)) - Environments with unavailable runners (missing plugins) are now gracefully skipped instead of causing a fatal error, shown with status "NOT AVAILABLE". If such an environment is explicitly requested with `-e`, a clear error message is shown indicating which runner is missing and that the plugin may not be installed. Unavailable environments in the configuration don't cause the overall run to fail by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3504](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3504)) - Add open-ended range expansion in generative env lists — `py3{9-}` expands up to the latest supported CPython minor version and `py3{-13}` expands down to the oldest supported one, both hardcoded at release time per the [Python release cycle](https://devguide.python.org/versions/) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3583](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3583)) - Add `--no-capture` (`-i`) CLI flag to disable output capture, allowing interactive programs like Python REPL to access the terminal directly. When enabled, subprocess inherits parent console handles instead of pipes, fixing issues where terminal APIs (e.g., querying console dimensions) fail on pipe handles. Mutually exclusive with `--result-json` and parallel mode by [@gaborjbernat](https://github.com/gaborjbernat). Fixes [#3635](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3635). ([#3635](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3635)) - Add `virtualenv_spec` configuration key that allows pinning a specific virtualenv version per environment (e.g. `virtualenv_spec = "virtualenv<20.22.0"`). When set, tox bootstraps the specified version in an isolated environment and drives it via subprocess, enabling environments targeting Python versions incompatible with the installed virtualenv by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3656](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3656)) ### Bug fixes - Suppress `BrokenPipeError` during backend teardown when interrupted, preventing traceback spam during KeyboardInterrupt by [@gaborjbernat](https://github.com/gaborjbernat). Fixes [#2660](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2660). ([#2660](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2660)) - Factor-specific multiline commands using backslash continuation (`\`) no longer leak continuation lines into environments that don't match the factor by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2912](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2912)) - `--list-dependencies` output is now printed to stdout during parallel runs. Previously, the dependency list was captured in suspended output buffers and only shown on failure by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3322](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3322)) - Compound factor conditionals (e.g., `np-cov: coverage`) now correctly allow their individual factors to be used when specifying environments with `-e`. Previously, running `tox -e py310-np-cov` with a factor conditional `np-cov: coverage` in the config would fail with "provided environments not found" because the individual factor `cov` was not recognized as combinable by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3780](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3780)) ### Documentation - Document Debian/Ubuntu `python3-venv` limitation in known limitations by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3195](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3195)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.42.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.41.0...4.42.0)

name: v4.41.0
body: ### Features - Add `package = "deps-only"` mode that installs the package's dependencies (including extras) without building or installing the package itself. For projects with static [PEP 621](https://peps.python.org/pep-0621/) metadata, dependencies are read directly from `pyproject.toml` without creating a packaging environment by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2301](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2301)) - Prefer TOML-native configuration (`[tool.tox]`) over `legacy_tox_ini` when both are present in `pyproject.toml`, allowing users to include a `legacy_tox_ini` section with `min_version` for older tox versions while using native TOML config for newer ones by [@rahuldevikar](https://github.com/rahuldevikar). ([#3402](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3402)) ### Bug fixes - Fix PEP 517 backend crash detection to handle both `ENOENT` (missing interpreter) and runtime crashes without hanging, and fix flaky `test_provision_install_pkg_pep517` integration test by using a pre-built wheel instead of an sdist to avoid devpi mirror dependency on setuptools by [@gaborjbernat](https://github.com/gaborjbernat). ([#3774](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3774)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.41.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.40.0...4.41.0)

name: v4.40.0
body: ### Features - Add `{glob:PATTERN}` substitution to expand file system glob/wildcard patterns in configuration values. Supports default values, recursive `**` matching, and both INI string syntax and TOML dict syntax (`{ replace = "glob", pattern = "..." }`) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1571](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1571)) - Add `commands_retry` configuration option to automatically retry failed commands by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1578](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1578)) - Automatically create a `.gitignore` file containing `*` in the tox work directory (typically `.tox/`) and in environment info directories, so that tox-managed files are not tracked by git by [@rahuldevikar](https://github.com/rahuldevikar). ([#2530](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2530)) - Add conditional value selection via `replace = "if"` in TOML configuration. Supports a `condition` expression with `env.VAR` lookups, `==`/`!=` comparisons, and `and`/`or`/`not` boolean logic to select between `then` and `else` values by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3650](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3650)) - Add `sdist-wheel` package type that builds a wheel from a source distribution, ensuring the sdist is complete and the package can be correctly built from it — by [@rahuldevikar](https://github.com/rahuldevikar). ([#3687](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3687)) ### Bug fixes - Use positive exit code (`1`) instead of `-1` when reporting failures across multiple environments. On Windows, `cmd.exe`'s `IF ERRORLEVEL 1` only matches exit codes `>= 1`, so the previous negative exit code was silently treated as success by [@radevika](https://github.com/radevika). Fixes [#2945](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2945). ([#2945](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2945)) - When `set_env` both inherits via cross-section substitution (e.g., `{[testenv]set_env}`) and explicitly overrides the same variable, the explicit value was incorrectly replaced by the inherited one because `load()` moved the key from the raw dict to the materialized dict before the deferred substitution ran, making the protection check ineffective by [@gaborjbernat](https://github.com/gaborjbernat). Fixes [#3773](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3773). ([#3773](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3773)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.40.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.39.0...4.40.0)

name: v4.39.0
body: ### Features - Create a `CACHEDIR.TAG` file in the tox work directory (`.tox`) so that backup and archiving tools (e.g., `tar --exclude-caches`, Borg, restic) can automatically skip it by [@radevika](https://github.com/radevika). ([#3334](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3334)) ### Bug fixes - On Windows, ANSI color codes from child processes (like pytest, mypy) are now rendered correctly in terminals by enabling VT100 processing mode for subprocess output streams by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2337](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2337)) - Concurrent tox processes no longer corrupt the provision environment (`.tox`) -- a file lock now serializes provisioning across processes by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2515](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2515)) - Config files (`tox.ini`, `setup.cfg`) with unicode characters are now read correctly on Windows when running tox with `python -m -I` (isolation mode) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2692](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2692)) - `set_env` values explicitly defined in a section now take precedence over values inherited via cross-section substitution (e.g., `{[testenv]set_env}`) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2831](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2831)) - The `-e` flag now supports brace expansion (e.g. `tox -e 'py{38,39}-pytest{6.x,7.x}'`) instead of incorrectly splitting on commas inside braces by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2850](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2850)) - Posargs containing colons no longer crash tox when an inactive environment uses `{posargs}` in path-like configuration values such as `env_dir` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2860](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2860)) - `set_env` values from cross-section substitution (e.g., `{[testenv]set_env}`) now correctly override default environment variables like `PYTHONHASHSEED` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2872](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2872)) - `--force-dep` now applies to package dependencies from project metadata (e.g. `setup.cfg` `install_requires`, `pyproject.toml` `dependencies`), not just tox config `deps` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2943](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2943)) - Using `{posargs}` in `change_dir` no longer causes a `RecursionError` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3062](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3062)) - Cross-section substitution (e.g. `{[testenv:a]commands}`) now resolves environment-specific variables like `{envpython}`, `{envbindir}`, `{envtmpdir}`, and `{envsitepackagesdir}` in the calling environment's context rather than the referenced environment's context by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3075](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3075)) - Fix `ValueError` crash when using posargs on Windows with `subst` drive mappings -- `os.path.relpath` fails across drive letters, so fall back to absolute paths when the relative path cannot be computed by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3086](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3086)) - `TOX_OVERRIDE` with `+=` (append) now works correctly when the override key name differs from the config file key name (e.g., overriding `pass_env` when config uses `passenv`, or vice versa) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3127](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3127)) - Fix spurious environment discovery from non-tox sections in `setup.cfg` -- `packages = find:` in `[options]` was incorrectly interpreted as a tox factor marker, creating a phantom `find` environment by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3134](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3134)) - Requirements in `requires` with environment markers that evaluate to false (e.g. `virtualenv<20.22.0; python_version < "3.8"`) are now correctly skipped during provisioning instead of causing an infinite provisioning loop by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3136](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3136)) - Running environments with `recreate = true` no longer destroys shared package environments (e.g. `.pkg`), which previously caused `FileNotFoundError` when a subsequent environment tried to use the already-built wheel by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3146](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3146)) - Factor-conditional config values (e.g. `base_python = py312: python3.12`) now correctly fall back to the default when no factors match the current environment, instead of producing an empty value by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3189](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3189)) - `TOX_PARALLEL_NO_SPINNER` / `--parallel-no-spinner` no longer forces parallel mode in the legacy command, fixing output suppression for sequential runs in CI by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3193](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3193)) - Multiple `-e` flags are now additive (`tox r -e a -e b` runs both `a` and `b`), matching tox 3 behavior by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3199](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3199)) - Environments like `functional-py312` no longer incorrectly match when only `functional{-py310}` is defined as a testenv section -- factors from section headers are no longer treated as freely combinable with CLI `-e` selections by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3219](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3219)) - On Windows, a trailing path separator (e.g. from `{/}`) no longer causes the next command argument to be merged into the path - backslash before whitespace is now treated as a literal path separator rather than a space escape by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3222](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3222)) - Fix `{envtmpdir}` and other env variable substitutions not expanding in external package environment commands by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3238](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3238)) ([#3238](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3238)) - On Windows, colored output is now preserved when running provisioned tox by explicitly passing the `--colored yes` flag to the provisioned subprocess when the parent has colors enabled by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3331](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3331)) - `set_env` values defined after a `file|` reference now correctly take precedence over values loaded from the env file by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3335](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3335)) - The `base` configuration key now works correctly in TOML format (`tox.toml` and `pyproject.toml`), allowing environments to inherit from arbitrary sections defined under `[env.*]` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3497](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3497)) - Skip `toxfile.py` inline plugin when it uses hooks not available in the current tox version instead of crashing - this allows provisioning to upgrade tox to a version that supports those hooks by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3593](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3593)) - `set_env` substitution referencing `{envsitepackagesdir}`, `{envbindir}`, or `{envpython}` for environments with missing interpreters now raises `Skip` instead of `RuntimeError`, allowing `skip_missing_interpreters` to work correctly by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3597](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3597)) - A `setup.cfg` without a `[tox:tox]` section no longer blocks discovery of `pyproject.toml` or `tox.toml` configuration files in the same directory by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3602](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3602)) - Fix pytest `INTERNALERROR` on Python 3.15 caused by Pygments using deprecated `os.path.commonprefix()` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3733](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3733)) - Fix `RecursionError` when TOML `set_env` contains substitutions like `{env_site_packages_dir}` that trigger config loading cycles -- the TOML loader now defers string substitution in `set_env` values, matching the INI loader's lazy resolution behavior by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3758](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3758)) ### Documentation - Document that interactive terminal programs (e.g., IPython) may not work correctly under tox due to the PTY-based output capture architecture by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2999](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2999)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.39.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.38.0...4.39.0)

name: v4.38.0
body: ### Features - Scope dependency rejection in PEP-517 package environments to only pure PEP-517 build types (`sdist`, `wheel`, `editable`), allowing non-standard package types like `editable-legacy` to specify dependencies by [@rahuldevikar](https://github.com/rahuldevikar). ([#3731](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3731)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.38.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.37.0...4.38.0)

name: v4.37.0
body: ### Features - Add `extra_setup_commands` configuration option to run commands after dependency and package installation but before test commands, useful with `--notest` for separating setup from execution by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1504](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1504)) ### Bug fixes - Set `PIP_USER=0` environment variable when running pip commands in virtualenvs to prevent pip from attempting `--user` installs when users have `pip config --user` configured globally — by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3010](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3010)) - Fix TOML env_run_base and env_pkg_base deps being clobbered when referenced with additional deps in testenv configuration ([#3393](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3393)) - Normalize extra names when resolving dependencies so that underscores and hyphens are treated equivalently (e.g. `extras = snake_case` now matches `Provides-Extra: snake-case` in wheel metadata) by [@Fridayai700](https://github.com/Fridayai700). ([#3433](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3433)) - Fix `setenv` modifications to `PATH` being overwritten when tox environment paths are set up by [@Fridayai700](https://github.com/Fridayai700) ([#3445](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3445)) - Fix `deps` entries with `~=` version specifier being incorrectly treated as local paths instead of being passed through to pip by [@Fridayai700](https://github.com/Fridayai700). ([#3447](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3447)) - Fix factor selection via `TOX_FACTORS` environment variable producing wrong results because `append` + `nargs="+"` actions need nested list types for proper env var conversion by [@Fridayai700](https://github.com/Fridayai700). ([#3557](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3557)) - Fix custom `install_command` being ignored when specified in TOML configuration (`tox.toml`/`pyproject.toml`) by [@Fridayai700](https://github.com/Fridayai700). ([#3574](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3574)) - Fix env names containing dots (e.g. `py3.11`) losing their description in TOML configuration by [@Fridayai700](https://github.com/Fridayai700). ([#3590](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3590)) - Run pre-commit on changelog.rst after towncrier build to ensure proper formatting before committing the release ([#3717](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3717)) - Fix type checker CI failure by adding `completion` extras to `type` and `type-min` environments so `ty` can resolve the `argcomplete` import by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3728](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3728)) ### Documentation - Restructured documentation using the Diátaxis framework to separate Tutorial, How-to guides, Reference, and Explanation content for better discoverability and user experience. ([#3718](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3718)) ### New Contributors - [@worksbyfriday](https://github.com/worksbyfriday) made their first contribution in [#3722](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3722) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.37.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.36.1...4.37.0)

name: v4.36.1
body: ### Bug fixes - Report TOML parse errors during config discovery instead of silently ignoring them by [@rahuldevikar](https://github.com/rahuldevikar). ([#3030](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3030)) - Adopt CPython's subprocess stream handling to fix deadlocks and improve performance when reading subprocess output ([#3715](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3715)) ### Documentation - Add Unix man page generation and installation support using sphinx-argparse-cli by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1409](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1409)) - Document use of Python `logging` for plugin authors in the how-to guides, covering verbosity levels, coloring, and best practices — by [@rahuldevikar](https://github.com/rahuldevikar). ([#3449](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3449)) - Add architecture documentation for new contributors under the development section by [@rahuldevikar](https://github.com/rahuldevikar) ([#3707](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3707)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.36.1/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.36.0...4.36.1)

### Features - Allow `skip_missing_interpreters` to be set per environment, overriding the global setting. This enables marking specific environments as optional while keeping others required. ([#435](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/435)) - Add `--fail-fast` CLI flag and `fail_fast` per-environment config option to stop executing remaining environments when the first failure occurs by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#578](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/578)) - Add shell completion support for bash, zsh, and fish via `argcomplete` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) ([#918](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/918)) - Validate that configured extras exist in package metadata, raising a clear error for unknown extras by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) ([#1113](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1113)) - Add glob pattern support in `depends` (e.g. `depends = py3*`) to match environments by wildcard instead of listing them explicitly by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) ([#1152](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1152)) - Add `disallow_pass_env` configuration option to exclude specific environment variables after `pass_env` glob expansion by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) ([#1387](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1387)) - Support `file:` URIs in `--installpkg` (e.g. `--installpkg file:///path/to/pkg.whl`), including proper handling of percent-encoded characters by [@rahuldevikar](https://github.com/rahuldevikar). ([#3498](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3498)) - Add GitHub Actions workflow dispatch for release preparation as alternative to local `tox r -e release` command by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) ([#3704](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3704)) ### Changes - Switch type checker from `mypy` to `ty` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3685](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3685)) ### Bug fixes - Raise an error when `deps` is configured on a PEP-517 packaging environment (e.g. `.pkg`), since build dependencies should be specified via the `[build-system]` table in `pyproject.toml` by [@rahuldevikar](https://github.com/rahuldevikar) ([#3412](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3412)) - Follow [FORCE_COLOR](https://force-color.org/) recommendations: any non-empty value now enables color (previously only `yes`, `true`, or `1` were accepted, and other values caused a crash). Also add support for `TTY_COMPATIBLE` (`1` forces color, `0` disables it) — by [@rahuldevikar](https://github.com/rahuldevikar). ([#3579](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3579)) - Return non-zero exit code from tox config when configuration exceptions occur. ([#3649](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3649)) - Fix flaky spinner test assertion caused by timing variations on slower systems. ([#3692](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3692)) ### Documentation - Document how to provide environments via `toxfile.py` inline plugins using `tox_extend_envs` and `MemoryLoader` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#828](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/828)) - Document shell completion setup for bash, zsh, and fish in the CLI reference by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) ([#918](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/918)) - Document negative factor conditions and multi-factor combinations with negation in the INI configuration reference by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) ([#3276](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3276)) - Add a substitution quick reference table covering all available `{...}` replacement variables by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) ([#3326](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3326)) - Add TOML configuration reference with complete examples for `tox.toml` and `pyproject.toml` formats, and emphasize TOML as the recommended format throughout by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) ([#3393](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3393)) - Document the `tox exec` subcommand with usage examples in the how-to guides by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) ([#3403](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3403)) - Comprehensive documentation improvements: added how-to guides for tox exec, CI/CD, coverage, build backends, labels, migration, debugging, and extras; expanded plugin documentation with all hook examples and packaging guide; added env var handling guide, factor conditions reference, and substitution quick reference; integrated docstrfmt for consistent RST formatting; fixed docstring issues in source code by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) ([#3475](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3475)) - Update `development.rst` to reflect current standards: replace references to `flake8`/`black`/`isort`/`pyupgrade` with `ruff`, remove outdated Python 2.7 compatibility note, and fix CI config filename by [@rahuldevikar](https://github.com/rahuldevikar) ([#3483](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3483)) - Drop `setup.py` mentions from the installation page — by [@rahuldevikar](https://github.com/rahuldevikar). ([#3588](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3588)) - Restructure documentation following the [Diataxis](https://diataxis.fr/) framework: add a step-by-step tutorial (`getting_started.rst`), consolidate how-to recipes (`howto.rst`), refocus the user guide on conceptual explanation, and move plugin docs into their own `plugins/` subdirectory. Remove the obsolete tox 3-to-4 migration guide (`upgrading.rst`) and FAQ, redistributing still-relevant content into the appropriate sections. All configuration examples now show TOML first with INI alongside by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) ([#3702](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3702)) ### New Contributors - [@veeceey](https://github.com/veeceey) made their first contribution in [#3683](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3683) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.36.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.35.0...4.36.0)

### Features - Show `toxfile.py` inline plugins in `tox --version` output, including any `tox_append_version_info()` result by [@rahuldevikar](https://github.com/rahuldevikar). ([#3514](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3514)) ### New Contributors - [@VedantMadane](https://github.com/VedantMadane) made their first contribution in [#3670](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3670) - [@mushitoriami](https://github.com/mushitoriami) made their first contribution in [#3675](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3675) - [@daniel7an](https://github.com/daniel7an) made their first contribution in [#3680](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3680) - [@rahuldevikar](https://github.com/rahuldevikar) made their first contribution in [#3681](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3681) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.35.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.34.1...4.35.0)

Syntax like py3{10-14} can be used in those sections now. by [@marcosboger](https://github.com/marcosboger) ([#3571](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3571)) ### Documentation - Add Python 3.14 and 3.14t to config examples by [@cclauss](https://github.com/cclauss) ([#3626](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3626)) ### New Contributors - [@neutrinoceros](https://github.com/neutrinoceros) made their first contribution in [#3629](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3629) - [@marcosboger](https://github.com/marcosboger) made their first contribution in [#3631](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3631) - [@ionelmc](https://github.com/ionelmc) made their first contribution in [#3634](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3634) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.32.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.31.0...4.32.0)

This has been fixed by properly tearing down the automatically provisioned environment after the tests. by [@vytas7](https://github.com/vytas7) ([#3600](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3600)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.30.2/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.30.1...4.30.2)

It was fixed internally, not to exhaust the underlying iterator on the first use. -- by [@webknjaz](https://github.com/webknjaz) ([#3598](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3598)) ### New Contributors - [@Liam-DeVoe](https://github.com/Liam-DeVoe) made their first contribution in [#3592](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3592) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.30.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.29.0...4.30.0)

It allows plugin authors to declare ephemeral environments that they can then populate through the in-memory configuration loader interface. This patch was made possible thanks to pair programming with [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) at PyCon US 2025. ([#3510](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3510), [#3591](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3591)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.29.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.28.4...4.29.0)

([#3090](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3090)) ### New Contributors - [@nschloe](https://github.com/nschloe) made their first contribution in [#3090](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3090) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.11.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.10.0...4.11.0)

### Features - Change accepted environment name rule: must be made up of factors defined in configuration or match regex `(pypy|py|cython|)((\d(\.\d+(\.\d+)?)?)|\d+)?`. If an environment name does not match this fail, and if a close match found suggest that to the user. ([#3099](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3099)) ### Bug fixes - `--override foo+=bar` appending syntax will now work correctly when `foo` wasn't defined in `tox.ini`. ([#3100](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3100)) ### New Contributors - [@BeyondEvil](https://github.com/BeyondEvil) made their first contribution in [#3099](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3099) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.10.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.9.0...4.10.0)

### Features - Disallow command line environments which are not explicitly specified in the config file by [@tjsmart](https://github.com/tjsmart). ([#2858](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2858)) ### New Contributors - [@tjsmart](https://github.com/tjsmart) made their first contribution in [#3089](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3089) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.9.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.8.0...4.9.0)

### Features - `--override` can now take options in the form of `foo+=bar` which will append `bar` to the end of an existing list/dict, rather than replacing it. ([#3087](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3087)) ### New Contributors - [@lamby](https://github.com/lamby) made their first contribution in [#3082](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3082) - [@stefanor](https://github.com/stefanor) made their first contribution in [#3088](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3088) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.8.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.7.0...4.8.0)

### Features - Make `--hashseed` default to `PYTHONHASHSEED`, if defined by [@paravoid](https://github.com/paravoid). The main motivation for this is to able to set the hash seed when building the documentation with `tox -e docs`, and thus avoid embedding a random value in the tox documentation for --help. This caused documentation builds to fail to build reproducibly. ([#2942](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2942)) ### Bug fixes - Update a regular expression in tests to match the exception message in both Python 3.12 and older. ([#3065](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3065)) ### Documentation - Fix broken links by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#3072](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3072)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.7.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.6.4...4.7.0)

### Bug fixes - Fix hang and zombie process on interrupt (CTRL-C). ([#3056](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3056)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.6.4/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.6.3...4.6.4)

### Bug fixes - Ensure that `get_requires_for_build_wheel` is called before `prepare_metadata_for_build_wheel`, and `get_requires_for_build_editable` is called before `prepare_metadata_for_build_editable` by [@abravalheri](https://github.com/abravalheri). ([#3043](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3043)) ### Documentation - Linked environment variable substitutions docs in `set_env` and `pass_env` config docs. ([#3039](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3039)) ### New Contributors - [@jamesbraza](https://github.com/jamesbraza) made their first contribution in [#3038](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3038) - [@abravalheri](https://github.com/abravalheri) made their first contribution in [#3044](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3044) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.6.3/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.6.2...4.6.3)

### Bug fixes - Avoid cache collision between editable wheel build and normal wheel build -- by [@f3flight](https://github.com/f3flight). ([#3035](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3035)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.6.2/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.6.1...4.6.2)

### New Contributors

- [@tibortakacs](https://github.com/tibortakacs) made their first contribution in [#3025](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3025)

[🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.6.1/)

[📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.6.0...4.6.1)

### Features - Added `--list-dependencies` and `--no-list-dependencies` CLI parameters. If unspecified, defaults to listing when in CI, but not otherwise. ([#3024](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/3024)) ### New Contributors - [@living180](https://github.com/living180) made their first contribution in [#3020](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3020) - [@lengau](https://github.com/lengau) made their first contribution in [#3024](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3024) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.6.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.5.2...4.6.0)

### Features - Add 3.12 support by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2998 ### Bug fixes - fix legacy `tox --devenv venv` by [@asottile](https://github.com/asottile) in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3013 - Fix legacy devenv by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/3019 [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.5.2/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.5.1...4.5.2)

name: Test Trusted Publisher
body: ### Bug fixes - Fix `tox --devenv venv` invocation without `-e` by [@asottile](https://github.com/asottile). ([#2925](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2925)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.5.1/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.5.0...4.5.1)

### Features - When run with verbosity=1, the per-step timing summaries are suppressed at the end of the run. Thanks to [@nedbat](https://github.com/nedbat) at the PyCon 2023 sprints. ([#2891](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2891)) ### Documentation - Add FAQ entry on how to test EOL Python versions by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00). ([#2989](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2989)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.5.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.4.12...4.5.0)

### Bug fixes - Avoid race conditions in tests using the `demo_pkg_inline` fixture. ([#2985](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2985)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.4.12/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.4.11...4.4.12)

### Bug fixes - Fixed an issue where a tox plugin couldn't change the value of `tox_root`. ([#2966](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2966)) ### New Contributors - [@kdestin](https://github.com/kdestin) made their first contribution in [#2978](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2978) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.4.11/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.4.10...4.4.11)

### Bug fixes - Fix issue where `work_dir` was not correctly including `tox_root` for test runs. ([#2933](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2933)) ### New Contributors - [@Tbruno25](https://github.com/Tbruno25) made their first contribution in [#2962](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2962) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.4.10/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.4.9...4.4.10)

### Bug fixes - Instead of raising `UnicodeDecodeError` when command output includes non-utf-8 bytes, `tox` will now use `surrogateescape` error handling to convert the unrecognized bytes to escape sequences according to [PEP 383](https://peps.python.org/pep-0383/) by [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf). ([#2969](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2969)) ### Documentation - Document running tox within a Docker container. ([#1035](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1035)) - Added python version 3.11 to `installation.rst`. ([#2964](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2964)) ### New Contributors - [@31z4](https://github.com/31z4) made their first contribution in [#2923](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2923) - [@ElBe-Plaq](https://github.com/ElBe-Plaq) made their first contribution in [#2964](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2964) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.4.9/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.4.8...4.4.9)

### Bug fixes - `tox.ini` is now included in source distributions in order to make all tests pass. ([#2939](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2939)) - Fix `--index-url` and `--find-links` being used together in `requirements.txt` files. ([#2959](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2959)) ### New Contributors - [@aelray](https://github.com/aelray) made their first contribution in [#2955](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2955) - [@sk1p](https://github.com/sk1p) made their first contribution in [#2960](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2960) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.4.8/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.4.7...4.4.8)

### Documentation - docs(config): fix temp_dir default value by [@thecesrom](https://github.com/thecesrom) in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2932 - docs: set html_last_updated_fmt to format string by [@paravoid](https://github.com/paravoid) in https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2937 ### New Contributors - [@cesarcoatl](https://github.com/cesarcoatl) made their first contribution in [#2932](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2932) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.4.7/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.4.6...4.4.7)

### Bug fixes - Plugins are now able to access tox.ini config sections using a custom prefix with the same suffix / name as a tox `testenv` by [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf) ([#2926](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2926)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.4.6/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.4.5...4.4.6)

### Bug fixes - Ignore labels when tox will provision a runtime environment (`.tox`) so that environment configurations which depend on provisioned plugins or specific tox versions are not accessed in the outer tox process where the configuration would be invalid by [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf). ([#2916](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2916)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.4.5/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.4.4...4.4.5)

### Bug fixes - Forward `HOME` by default by [@gschaffner](https://github.com/gschaffner). ([#2702](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2702)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.4.4/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.4.3...4.4.4)

### Bug fixes - Tox will now expand self-referential extras discovered in package deps to respect local modifications to package metadata. This allows a package extra to explicitly depend on another package extra, which previously only worked with non-static metadata by [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf). ([#2904](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2904)) ### New Contributors - [@sparkiegeek](https://github.com/sparkiegeek) made their first contribution in [#2900](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2900) - [@gschaffner](https://github.com/gschaffner) made their first contribution in [#2908](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2908) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.4.3/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.4.2...4.4.3)

### Bug fixes - Allow the user configuration file (default `/tox/config.ini`) to be overridden via the `TOX_USER_CONFIG_FILE` environment variable. Previously tox was looking at the `TOX_CONFIG_FILE` to override the user configuration, however that environment variable is already used to override the main configuration by [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf). ([#2890](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2890)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.4.2/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.4.1...4.4.2)

### Bug fixes - In tox 4.4.0 `constrain_package_deps` was introduced with a default value of `True`. This has been changed back to `False`, which restores the original behavior of tox 4.3.5 by [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf). ([#2897](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2897)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.4.1/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.4.0...4.4.1)

### Features - Test environments now recognize boolean config keys `constrain_package_deps` (default=true) and `use_frozen_constraints` (default=false), which control how tox generates and applies constraints files when performing `install_package_deps`. If `constrain_package_deps` is true (default), then tox will write out `{env_dir}{/}constraints.txt` and pass it to `pip` during `install_package_deps`. If `use_frozen_constraints` is false (default), the constraints will be taken from the specifications listed under `deps` (and inside any requirements or constraints file referenced in `deps`). Otherwise, `list_dependencies_command` (`pip freeze`) is used to enumerate exact package specifications which will be written to the constraints file. In previous releases, conflicting package dependencies would silently override the `deps` named in the configuration, resulting in test runs against unexpected dependency versions, particularly when using tox factors to explicitly test with different versions of dependencies by [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf). ([#2386](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2386)) ### Bug fixes - When parsing command lines, use `shlex(..., posix=True)`, even on windows platforms, since non-POSIX mode does not handle escape characters and quoting like a shell would. This improves cross-platform configurations without hacks or esoteric quoting. To make this transition easier, on Windows, the backslash path separator will not treated as an escape character unless it precedes a quote, whitespace, or another backslash character. This allows paths to mostly be written in single or double backslash style. Note that **double-backslash will no longer be escaped to a single backslash in substitutions**, instead the double backslash will be consumed as part of command splitting, on either posix or windows platforms. In some instances superfluous double or single quote characters may be stripped from arg arrays in ways that do not occur in the default windows `cmd.exe` shell by [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf). ([#2635](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2635)) ### Documentation - Add information when command from `list_dependencies_command` configuration option is used. ([#2883](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2883)) ### New Contributors - [@Czaki](https://github.com/Czaki) made their first contribution in [#2883](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2883) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.4.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.3.5...4.4.0)

### Bug fixes - When building a `wheel` or `editable` package with a PEP 517 backend, no longer pass an empty `metadata_directory` to the backend `build_wheel` or `build_editable` endpoint. Some backends, such as PDM and poetry, will not generate package metadata in the presence of a `metadata_directory`, even if it is empty. Prior to this change, attempting to install a wheel created by tox using PDM or poetry would return an error like "There is no item named 'my-package.0.1.dist-info/WHEEL' in the archive" by [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf). ([#2880](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2880)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.3.5/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.3.4...4.3.5)

### Bug fixes - When executing via the provisioning environment (`.tox` by default), run `tox` in working directory of the parent process. Prior to this change (from tox 4.0.0), the provisioned `tox` would execute with `{tox_root}` as the working directory, which breaks when a relative path is passed to `-c` or `--conf` and `tox` is executed in a working directory other than `{tox_root}` by [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf). ([#2876](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2876)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.3.4/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.3.3...4.3.4)

### Bug fixes - The provision environment (`.tox`) will never inherit from `testenv`. During provisioning, other test environments are not processed, allowing the use of keys and values that may be registered by later tox version or provisioned plugins by [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf). ([#2862](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2862)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.3.3/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.3.2...4.3.3)

### Bug fixes - Fix regression introduced in 4.3.0 which occurred when a substitution expression for an environment variable that had previously been substituted appears in the ini file after a substitution expression for a different environment variable. This situation erroneously resulted in an exception about "circular chain between set" of those variables by [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf). ([#2869](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2869)) ### New Contributors - [@kurtmckee](https://github.com/kurtmckee) made their first contribution in [#2867](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2867) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.3.2/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.3.1...4.3.2)

### Bug fixes - Fix regression introduced in 4.3.0 by expanding substitution expressions (`{...}`) that result from a previous subsitution's replacement value (up to 100 times). Note that recursive expansion is strictly depth-first; no replacement value will ever affect adjacent characters nor will expansion ever occur over the result of more than one replacement by [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf). ([#2863](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2863)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.3.1/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.3.0...4.3.1)

### Features - Rewrite substitution replacement parser by [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf) - `\` acts as a proper escape for `\` in ini-style substitutions - The resulting value of a substitution is no longer reprocessed in the context of the broader string. (Prior to this change, ini-values were repeatedly re-substituted until the expression no longer had modifications) - Migrate and update "Substitutions" section of Configuration page from v3 docs. - `find_replace_part` is removed from `tox.config.loader.ini.replace` - New names exported from `tox.config.loader.ini.replace`: - `find_replace_expr` - `MatchArg` - `MatchError` - `MatchExpression` - Note: the API for `replace` itself is unchanged. ([#2732](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2732)) - Improved documentation for factors and test env names by [@stephenfin](https://github.com/stephenfin). ([#2852](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2852)) ### New Contributors - [@kerel-fs](https://github.com/kerel-fs) made their first contribution in [#2854](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2854) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.3.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.2.8...4.3.0)

### Bug fixes - Allow using package names with env markers for pip's `--no-binary` and `--only-binary` options by [@q0w](https://github.com/q0w). ([#2814](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2814)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.2.8/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.2.7...4.2.8)

### Bug fixes - A testenv with multiple factors, one of which conflicts with a `base_python` setting in `tox.ini`, will now use the correct Python interpreter version by [@stephenfin](https://github.com/stephenfin). ([#2838](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2838)) - Explicitly list `wheel` as requirement for the tests, as some of the tests error without it. ([#2843](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2843)) - tox has reverted support for Python factors that include PATCH release info (e.g. `py3.10.1`), build architecture (e.g. `pypy3-64`) or do not define a `py` prefix or other supported prefix (e.g. `3.10`). These complex factors were initially supported with the release of tox 4.0 but has proven complicated to support. Instead, the simple factors supported by tox 3 e.g. (`py310`, `pypy3`) or period-separated equivalent (`py3.10`) introduced in tox 4 should be used. Users who wish to specify more specific Python version information should configure the `base_python` setting by [@stephenfin](https://github.com/stephenfin). ([#2848](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2848)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.2.7/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.2.6...4.2.7)

### Bug fixes - Handle properly pip `--no-binary` / `--only-binary` options in requirements.txt format files. ([#2814](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2814)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.2.6/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.2.5...4.2.6)

### Bug fixes - The combination of `usedevelop = true` and `--skip-missing-interpreters=false` will no longer fail for environments that were *not* invoked by [@stephenfin](https://github.com/stephenfin). ([#2811](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2811)) - Fix an attribute error when `use_develop = true` is set and an unsupported interpreter version is requested by [@stephenfin](https://github.com/stephenfin). ([#2826](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2826)) - tox returns a non-zero error code if all envs are skipped. It will now correctly do this if only a single env was requested and this was skipped by [@stephenfin](https://github.com/stephenfin). ([#2827](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2827)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.2.5/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.2.4...4.2.5)

### Bug fixes - Setting `[testenv] basepython = python3` will no longer override the Python interpreter version requested by a factor, such as `py311` by [@stephenfin](https://github.com/stephenfin). ([#2754](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2754)) - Also accept tab after colon before factor filter expansion by [@pdecat](https://github.com/pdecat). ([#2823](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2823)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.2.4/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.2.3...4.2.4)

### Bug fixes - `devenv` does not respect the specified path when the package is a wheel file by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2815](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2815)) - Require space after colon before factor filter expansion, unless it is the last character of the line by [@pdecat](https://github.com/pdecat). ([#2822](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2822)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.2.3/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.2.2...4.2.3)

### Bug fixes - Add `CC`, `CFLAGS`, `CCSHARED`, `CXX`, `CPPFLAGS`, `LDFLAGS`, `PKG_CONFIG` and `PKG_CONFIG_SYSROOT_DIR` to the default passed through environment variables list as these are needed for building various C-extensions by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). body: ### Features - Add `--exit-and-dump-after` flag that allows automatically killing tox if does not finish within the passed seconds, and dump the thread stacks (useful to debug tox when it seemingly hangs) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2594](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2594)) - Fix leaking backend processes when the build backend does not support editable wheels and fix failure when multiple environments exist that have a build backend that does not support editable wheels by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). body: ### Features - Support for recursive extras in Python package dependencies by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat).
