### Bug fixes - Replaced deprecated `license_file` key with `license_files` in `setup.cfg` -- by [@mgorny](https://github.com/mgorny). [#2521](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2521) - Add env cleanup to envreport - fix PYTHONPATH leak into "envreport" -- by [@f3flight](https://github.com/f3flight). [#2528](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2528) ### New Contributors - [@mgorny](https://github.com/mgorny) made their first contribution in [#2521](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2521) - [@f3flight](https://github.com/f3flight) made their first contribution in [#2529](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2529) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.27.1/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.27.0...3.27.1)

### Bug fixes - Dropped `--build-option` in isolated builds, an alternative fix for the `SetuptoolsDeprecationWarning` about using `--global-option` -- by [@adamchainz](https://github.com/adamchainz) [#2497](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2497) - Remove read-only files in `ensure_empty_dir`. [#2498](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2498) - Multiple tox instances no longer clobber the `.tox` directory when `provision_tox_env` is used. by [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf) [#2515](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2515) ### Documentation - Clarify that `install_command` only takes one command by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00) [#2433](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2433) - Documented problems with plugin and provision env by [@ziima](https://github.com/ziima). [#2469](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2469) ### New Contributors - [@robgom](https://github.com/robgom) made their first contribution in [#2501](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2501) - [@masenf](https://github.com/masenf) made their first contribution in [#2516](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2516) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.27.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.26.0...3.27.0)

### Features - Use `tomllib` on Python 3.11 or later and `tomli` instead of `toml` library on lower versions by [@hroncok](https://github.com/hroncok). [#2463](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2463) ### Bug fixes - Fix fallback to `python` environment when `isolated_build = true` is set -- by [@Unrud](https://github.com/Unrud) [#2474](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2474) - Fixed `SetuptoolsDeprecationWarning` about using `--global-option` -- by [@adamchainz](https://github.com/adamchainz) [#2478](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2478) ### New Contributors - [@Unrud](https://github.com/Unrud) made their first contribution in [#2475](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2475) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.26.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.25.1...3.26.0)

### Bug fixes - `sitepackages = true` will add user's site-package to the python path on Windows as expected -- by [@niander](https://github.com/niander) [#2402](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2402) - Avoid importing `pipes` on Python 3.3+ to avoid `DeprecationWarning` on Python 3.11 -- by [@adamchainz](https://github.com/adamchainz) [#2417](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2417) - Fix `isolated_build` when the build process produces stderr at exit. [#2449](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2449) ### Documentation - Explain advantages of `PIP_CONSTRAINT` environment variable over `--constraint` argument. [#2423](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2423) ### New Contributors - [@niander](https://github.com/niander) made their first contribution in [#2404](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2404) - [@adamchainz](https://github.com/adamchainz) made their first contribution in [#2407](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2407) - [@mxd4](https://github.com/mxd4) made their first contribution in [#2413](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2413) - [@apljungquist](https://github.com/apljungquist) made their first contribution in [#2423](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2423) - [@deadnews](https://github.com/deadnews) made their first contribution in [#2448](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2448) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.25.1/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.25.0...3.25.1)

name: 4.0.0b2
body: ### Features - Use `tox` console entry point name instead of `tox4` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2344](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2344)) - Use `.tox` as working directory instead of `.tox/4` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2346](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2346)) - Switch to `hatchling` as build backend instead of `setuptools` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2368](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2368)) ### Bug fixes - Fix CLI raises an error for `-va` with `ignored explicit argument 'a'` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2343](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2343)) - Do not interpolate values when parsing `tox.ini` configuration files by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2350](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2350)) ### Documentation - Deleted the tox mailing list -- by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00) ([#2364](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2364)) ### New Contributors - [@nhtsai](https://github.com/nhtsai) made their first contribution in [#2387](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2387) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.0.0b2/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.0.0b1...4.0.0b2)

### Features - Ignore missing commands if they are prefixed by `-` -- by [@cdown](https://github.com/cdown). [#2315](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2315) - Add default environment variables (such as http_proxy) regardless of their case to passenv on UNIX -- by [@poggenhans](https://github.com/poggenhans). [#2372](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2372) - On Windows `PROGRAMFILES`, `PROGRAMFILES(X86)`, and `PROGRAMDATA` environment variables are now passed through, unmasking system values necessary to locate resources such as a C compiler. [#2382](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2382) ### Bug fixes - Fixed failing isolated_build because setuptools warning was captured in `build_requires`. -- by [@zariiii9003](https://github.com/zariiii9003) [#2332](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2332) - Avoid potential 30s delay caused by socket.getfqdn(). -- by [@ssbarnea](https://github.com/ssbarnea) [#2375](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2375) ### Documentation - Deleted the tox mailing list -- by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00) [#2364](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2364) ### New Contributors - [@cdown](https://github.com/cdown) made their first contribution in [#2316](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2316) - [@zariiii9003](https://github.com/zariiii9003) made their first contribution in [#2333](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2333) - [@vladdoster](https://github.com/vladdoster) made their first contribution in [#2363](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2363) - [@poggenhans](https://github.com/poggenhans) made their first contribution in [#2378](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2378) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.25.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.24.5...3.25.0)

### Features - Display a hint for unrecognized argument CLI parse failures to use `--` separator to pass arguments to commands by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2183](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2183)) - Do not allow extending the config set beyond setup to ensures that all configuration values are visible via the config sub-command. by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2243](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2243)) - Print a message when ignoring outcome of commands by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2315](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2315)) ### Bug fixes - Fix type annotation is broken for `add_config` when adding a container type by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2233](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2233)) - Insert `TOX_WORK_DIR`, `TOX_ENV_NAME`, `TOX_ENV_DIR` and `VIRTUAL_ENV` into the environment variables for all tox environments to keep contract with tox version 3 by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2259](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2259)) - Fix plugin initialization order - core plugins first, then 3rd party and finally inline by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2264](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2264)) - Legacy parallel mode should accept `-p` flag without arguments by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2299](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2299)) - Sequential run fails because the packaging environment is deleted twice for sequential runs with recreate flag on by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2300](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2300)) - Require Python 3.10 to generate docs by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00). ([#2321](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2321)) - Environment assignment for output breaks when using `-rv` (when we cannot guess upfront the verbosity level from the CLI arguments) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2324](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2324)) - `devenv` command does not respect specified path by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2325](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2325)) ### Documentation - Enable link check during documentation build by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#806](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/806)) - Document ownership of the `tox.wiki` root domain by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2242](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2242)) - Document `loaders` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2287](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2287)) - Fix CLI documentation is missing and broken documentation references by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2310](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2310)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.0.0b1/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.0.0a10...4.0.0b1)

### Features - Support for grouping environment values together by applying labels to them either at `core` and `environment` level, and allow selecting them via the `-m` flag from the CLI by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#238](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/238)) - Support for environment files within the `set_env` configuration via the `file|` prefix by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1938](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1938)) - Support for `--no-provision` flag by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1951](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1951)) - Missing `pyproject.toml` or `setup.py` file at the tox root folder without the `--install-pkg` flag assumes no packaging by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1964](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1964)) - Add `external` package type for `package` (see `external-package-builder`), and extract package dependencies for packages passed in via `--installpkg` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2204](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2204)) - Add support for rewriting script invocations that have valid shebang lines when the `TOX_LIMITED_SHEBANG` environment variable is set and not empty by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2208](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2208)) - Support for the `--discover` CLI flag by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2245](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2245)) - Moved the python packaging logic into a dedicate package `pyproject-api` and use it as a dependency by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2274](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2274)) - Drop python 3.6 support by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2275](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2275)) - Support for selecting target environments with a given factor via the `-f` CLI environment flag by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2290](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2290)) ### Bug fixes - Fix `CTRL+C` is not stopping the process on Windows by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2159](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2159)) - Fix list/depends commands can create tox package environment as runtime environment and display an error message by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2234](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2234)) ### Deprecations - `tox_add_core_config` and `tox_add_env_config` now take a `state: State` argument instead of a configuration one, and `Config` not longer provides the `envs` property (instead users should migrate to `State.envs`) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2275](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2275)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.0.0a10/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.0.0a9...4.0.0a10)

### Bug fixes - Fixed an issue where `usedevelop` would cause an invocation error if setup.py does not exist. -- by [@VincentVanlaer](https://github.com/VincentVanlaer) [#2197](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2197) ### New Contributors - [@kianmeng](https://github.com/kianmeng) made their first contribution in [#2253](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2253) - [@VincentVanlaer](https://github.com/VincentVanlaer) made their first contribution in [#2273](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2273) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.24.5/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.24.4...3.24.5)

### Features - Expose the parsed CLI arguments on the main configuration object for plugins and allow plugins to define their own configuration section -- by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2191](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2191)) - Let tox run fail when all envs are skipped -- by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00). ([#2195](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2195)) - Expose the configuration loading mechanism to plugins to define and load their own sections. Add `tox_add_env_config` plugin hook called after the configuration environment is created for a tox environment and removed `tox_configure`. Add the main configuration object as argument to `tox_add_core_config`. Move the environment list method from the state to the main configuration object to allow its use within plugins -- by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2200](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2200)) - Allow running code in plugins before and after commands via `tox_before_run_commands` and `tox_after_run_commands` plugin points -- by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2201](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2201)) - Allow plugins to update the `set_env` and change the `pass_env` configurations -- by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2215](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2215)) ### Bug fixes - Fix env variable substitutions with defaults containing colon (e.g. URL) -- by [@comabrewer](https://github.com/comabrewer). ([#2182](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2182)) - Do not allow constructing `ConfigSet` directly and implement `__contains__` for `Loader` -- by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2209](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2209)) - Fix old-new value on recreate cache miss-match are swapped -- by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2211](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2211)) - Report fails when report does not support Unicode characters -- by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2213](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2213)) ### Documentation - Adopt furo theme, update our state diagram and description in user docs (SVG + light/dark variant), split the Python API into its own page from under the plugin page, and document plugin adoption under the `tox-dev` organization by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1881](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1881)) ### New Contributors - [@comabrewer](https://github.com/comabrewer) made their first contribution in [#2186](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2186) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.0.0a9/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.0.0a8...4.0.0a9)

### Bug fixes - Fixed handling of `-e ALL` in parallel mode by ignoring the `ALL` in subprocesses -- by [@guahki](https://github.com/guahki). [#2167](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2167) - Prevent tox from using a truncated interpreter when using `TOX_LIMITED_SHEBANG` -- by [@jdknight](https://github.com/jdknight). [#2208](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2208) ### Documentation - Enabled the use of the favicon in the Sphinx docs first introduced in [#764](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/764) but not integrated fully -- [@webknjaz](https://github.com/webknjaz) [#2177](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2177) ### New Contributors - [@guahki](https://github.com/guahki) made their first contribution in [#2207](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2207) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.24.4/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.24.3...3.24.4)

name: 4.0.0a8
body: ### Features - Add support for `allowlist_externals`, commands not matching error by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1127](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1127)) - Add outcome of environments into the result json (`--result-json`) under the `result` key containing `success` boolean, `exit_code` integer and `duration` float value by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1405](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1405)) - Add `exec` subcommand that allows users to run an arbitrary command within the tox environment (without needing to modify their configuration) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1790](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1790)) - Add check to validate the base Python names and the environments name do not conflict Python spec wise, when they do raise error if `ignore_base_python_conflict` is not set or `False` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1840](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1840)) - Allow any Unix shell-style wildcards expression for `pass_env` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2121](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2121)) - Add support for `args_are_paths` flag by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2122](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2122)) - Add support for `env_log_dir` (compared to tox 3 extend content and keep only last run entries) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2123](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2123)) - Add support for `{:}` substitution in ini files as placeholder for the OS path separator by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2125](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2125)) - When cleaning directories (for tox environment, `env_log_dir`, `env_tmp_dir` and packaging metadata folders) do not delete the directory itself and recreate, but instead just delete its content (this allows the user to cd into it and still be in a valid folder after a new run) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2139](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2139)) - Changes to help plugin development: simpler tox env creation argument list, expose python creation directly, allow skipping list dependencies install command for pip and executable is only part of the python cache for virtualenv by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2172](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2172)) ### Bug fixes - Support `#` character in path for the tox project by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#763](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/763)) - If the command expression fails to parse with shlex fallback to literal pass through of the remaining elements by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1944](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1944)) - tox config fails on `--recreate` flag, and once specified the output does not reflect the impact of the CLI flags by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2037](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2037)) - Virtual environment creation for Python is always triggered at every run by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2041](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2041)) - Add support for setting `suicide_timeout`, `interrupt_timeout` and `terminate_timeout` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2124](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2124)) - Parallel show output not working when there's a packaging phase in the run by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2161](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2161)) ### Documentation - Note constraint files are a subset of requirement files by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1939](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1939)) - Add a note about having a package with different Python requirements than tox and not specifying `base_python` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1975](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1975)) - Fix `--runner` is missing default value and documentation unclear by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2004](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2004)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.0.0a8/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.0.0a7...4.0.0a8)

### Bug fixes - `--parallel` reports now show ASCII OK/FAIL/SKIP lines when full Unicode output is not available by [@brettcs](https://github.com/brettcs) [#1421](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1421) ### Documentation - Started enforcing valid references in Sphinx docs -- [@webknjaz](https://github.com/webknjaz) [#2168](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2168) ### New Contributors - [@brettcs](https://github.com/brettcs) made their first contribution in [#2164](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2164) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.24.3/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.24.2...3.24.3)

### Bug fixes - include `LC_ALL` to implicit list of passenv variables by [@ssbarnea](https://github.com/ssbarnea) [#2162](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2162) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.24.2/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.24.1...3.24.2)

### Bug fixes - `get_requires_for_build_sdist` hook (PEP 517) is assumed to return an empty list if left unimplemented by the backend build system by [@oczkoisse](https://github.com/oczkoisse) [#2130](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2130) ### Documentation - The documentation of `install_command` now also mentions that you can provide arbitrary commands by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00) [#2081](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2081) ### New Contributors - [@pdecat](https://github.com/pdecat) made their first contribution in [#2113](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2113) - [@oczkoisse](https://github.com/oczkoisse) made their first contribution in [#2131](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2131) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.24.1/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.24.0...3.24.1)

name: 4.0.0a7
body: ### Features - Add support for configuration taken from the `setup.cfg` file -by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1836](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1836)) - Add support for configuration taken from the `pyproject.toml` file, `tox` section `legacy_tox_ini` key by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1837](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1837)) - Add configuration documentation by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1914](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1914)) - Implemented `[]` substitution (alias for `{posargs}`) by [@hexagonrecursion](https://github.com/hexagonrecursion). ([#1928](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1928)) - Implement `[testenv] ignore_outcome` - "a failing result of this testenv will not make tox fail" by [@hexagonrecursion](https://github.com/hexagonrecursion). ([#1947](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1947)) - Inline plugin support via `tox_.py`. This is loaded where the tox config source is discovered. It's a Python file that can contain arbitrary Python code, such as definition of a plugin. Eventually we'll add a plugin that allows succinct declaration/generation of new tox environments by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1963](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1963)) - Introduce the installer concept, and collect pip installation into a `pip` package, also attach to this the requirements file parsing which got a major rework by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1991](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1991)) - Support CPython `3.10` -by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2014](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2014)) ### Bug fixes - Environments with a platform mismatch are no longer silently skipped, but properly reported by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00). ([#1926](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1926)) - Port pip requirements file parser to `tox` to achieve full equivalency (such as support for the per requirement `--install-option` and `--global-option` flags) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1929](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1929)) - Support for extras with paths for Python deps and requirement files by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1933](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1933)) - Due to a bug `\{posargs} {posargs}` used to expand to literal `{posargs} {posargs}`. Now the second `{posargs}` is expanded. `\{posargs} {posargs}` expands to `{posargs} positional arguments here` by [@hexagonrecursion](https://github.com/hexagonrecursion). ([#1956](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1956)) - Enable setting a different `upstream` repository for the coverage diff report. This has been hardcoded to `upstream/rewrite` until now. by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00). ([#1972](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1972)) - Enable replacements (a.k.a section substitutions) for section names containing a dash in sections without the `testenv:` prefix by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00), [@obestwalter](https://github.com/obestwalter), [@eumiro](https://github.com/eumiro). ([#1985](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1985)) - Fix legacy list env command for empty/missing envlist by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00). ([#1987](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1987)) - Requirements and constraints files handling got reimplemented, which should fix all open issues related to this area by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1991](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1991)) - Use importlib instead of `__import__` by [@dmendek](https://github.com/dmendek). ([#1995](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1995)) - Evaluate factor conditions for `command` keys by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00). ([#2002](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2002)) - Prefer f-strings instead of the str.format method by [@eumiro](https://github.com/eumiro). ([#2012](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2012)) - Fix regex validation for SHA 512 hashes by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00). ([#2018](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2018)) - Actually run all environments when `ALL` is provided to the legacy env command by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00). ([#2112](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2112)) - Move from `appdirs` to `platformdirs` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2117](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2117)) - Move from `toml` to `tomli` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#2118](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2118)) ### Documentation - Start documenting the plugin interface. Added `tox_register_tox_env`, `tox_add_option`, `tox_add_core_config`, `tox_configure` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1991](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1991)) - Explain how `-v` and `-q` flags play together to determine CLI verbosity level by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00). ([#2005](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2005)) - Start polishing the documentation for the upcoming final release by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00). ([#2006](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2006)) - Update documentation about changelog entries for trivial changes by [@jugmac00](https://github.com/jugmac00). ([#2007](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2007)) ### New Contributors - [@hexagonrecursion](https://github.com/hexagonrecursion) made their first contribution in [#1936](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1936) - [@dmendek](https://github.com/dmendek) made their first contribution in [#2035](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2035) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.0.0a7/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.0.0a6...4.0.0a7)

### Bug fixes - `--devenv` no longer modifies the directory in which the `.tox` environment is provisioned by [@isaac-ped](https://github.com/isaac-ped) [#2065](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2065) - Fix show config when the package names are not in canonical form by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). [#2103](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2103) ### Documentation - Extended environment variables section by [@majiang](https://github.com/majiang) [#2036](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2036) ### Deprecations - `tox` no longer shows deprecation warnings for `distutils.sysconfig` on Python 3.10 by [@9999years](https://github.com/9999years) [#2100](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2100) ### New Contributors - [@isaac-ped](https://github.com/isaac-ped) made their first contribution in [#2066](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2066) - [@chayim](https://github.com/chayim) made their first contribution in [#2075](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2075) - [@majiang](https://github.com/majiang) made their first contribution in [#2076](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2076) - [@9999years](https://github.com/9999years) made their first contribution in [#2100](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2100) - [@hukkin](https://github.com/hukkin) made their first contribution in [#2101](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2101) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.24.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.23.1...3.24.0)

### Bug fixes - Distinguish between normal Windows Python and MSYS2 Python when looking for virtualenv executable path. Adds os.sep to `tox.interpreters.InterpreterInfo` by [@jschwartzentruber](https://github.com/jschwartzentruber) [#1982](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1982) - Fix a `tox-conda` isolation build bug by [@AntoineD](https://github.com/AntoineD). [#2056](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/2056) ### Documentation - Update examples in the documentation to use `setenv` in the `[testenv]` sections, not wrongly in the `[tox]` main section. by [@AndreyNautilus](https://github.com/AndreyNautilus) [#1999](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1999) ### Packaging - Enable building tox with `setuptools_scm` 6+ by [@hroncok](https://github.com/hroncok) [#1984](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1984) ### New Contributors - [@zejn](https://github.com/zejn) made their first contribution in [#1976](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1976) - [@jschwartzentruber](https://github.com/jschwartzentruber) made their first contribution in [#1983](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1983) - [@AndreyNautilus](https://github.com/AndreyNautilus) made their first contribution in [#2016](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2016) - [@tirkarthi](https://github.com/tirkarthi) made their first contribution in [#2033](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2033) - [@noviluni](https://github.com/noviluni) made their first contribution in [#2052](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2052) - [@AntoineD](https://github.com/AntoineD) made their first contribution in [#2056](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/2056) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.23.1/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.23.0...3.23.1)

### Features - tox can now be invoked with a new `--no-provision` flag that prevents provision, if `requires` or `minversion` are not satisfied, tox will fail; if a path is specified as an argument to the flag (e.g. as `tox --no-provision missing.json`) and provision is prevented, provision metadata are written as JSON to that path by [@hroncok](https://github.com/hroncok) [#1921](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1921) - Unicode support in `pyproject.toml` by [@domdfcoding](https://github.com/domdfcoding) [#1940](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1940) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.23.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.22.0...3.23.0)

### Features - The value of the `requires` configuration option is now exposed via the `tox.config.Config` object by [@hroncok](https://github.com/hroncok) [#1918](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1918) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.22.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.21.4...3.22.0)

name: 4.0.0a6
body: ### Features - Add basic quickstart implementation (just use pytest with the current Python version) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1829](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1829)) - Support comments via the `#` character within the ini configuration (to force a literal `#` use `\#`) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1831](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1831)) - Add support for the `install_command` settings in the virtual env test environments by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1832](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1832)) - Add support for the `package_root` `setupdir` ( Python scoped) configuration that sets the root directory used for packaging (the location of the historical `setup.py` and modern `pyproject.toml`). This can be set at root level, or at tox environment level (the later takes precedence over the former) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1838](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1838)) - Implement support for the `--installpkg` CLI flag by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1839](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1839)) - Add support for the `list_dependencies_command` settings in the virtual env test environments by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1842](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1842)) - Add support for the `ignore_errors` settings in tox test environments by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1843](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1843)) - Add support for the `pip_pre` settings for virtual environment based tox environments by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1844](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1844)) - Add support for the `platform` settings in tox test environments by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1845](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1845)) - Add support for the `recreate` settings in tox test environments by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1846](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1846)) - Allow Python test and packaging environments with version 2.7 by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1900](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1900)) - Do not construct a requirements file for deps in virtualenv, instead pass content as CLI argument to pip by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1906](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1906)) - Do not display status update environment reports when interrupted or for the final environment ran (because at the final report will be soon printed and makes the status update redundant) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1909](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1909)) - The `_TOX_SHOW_THREAD` environment variable can be used to print alive threads when tox exists (useful to debug when tox hangs because of some non-finished thread) and also now prints the pid of the local subprocess when reporting the outcome of an execution by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1915](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1915)) ### Bug fixes - Normalize description text to collapse newlines and one or more than whitespace to a single space by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1829](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1829)) - Support aliases in show config key specification (will print with the primary key) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1831](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1831)) - Show config no longer marks as unused keys that are inherited (e.g. if the key is coming from `testenv` section and our target is `testenv:fix`) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1833](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1833)) - `--alwayscopy` and `--sitepackages` legacy only flags do not work by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1839](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1839)) - Fix handling of `commands_pre`/`commands`/`commands_post` to be in line with tox 3 (returned incorrect exit codes and post was not always executed) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1843](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1843)) - Support requirement files containing `--hash` constraints by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1903](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1903)) - Fix a bug that caused tox to never finish when pulling configuration from a tox run environment that was never executed by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1915](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1915)) ### Deprecations - - Drop support for `sdistsrc` flag because introduces a significant complexity and is barely used (5 hits on a github search). - `--skip-missing-interpreters`, `--notest`, `--sdistonly`, `--installpkg`, `--develop` and `--skip-pkg-install` CLI flags are no longer available for `devenv` (enforce the only sane value for these). By [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) ([#1839](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1839)) - Remove Jenkins override support: this feature goes against the spirit of tox - blurring the line between the CI and local runs. It also singles out a single CI provider, which opens the door for other CIs wanting similar functionality. Finally, only 54 code file examples came back on a Github search, showing this is a not widely used feature. People who still want Jenkins override support may create a tox plugin to achieve this functionality by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1841](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1841)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.0.0a6/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.0.0a5...4.0.0a6)

### Bug fixes - Adapt tests not to assume the `easy_install` command exists, as it was removed from `setuptools` 52.0.0+ by [@hroncok](https://github.com/hroncok) [#1893](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1893) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.21.4/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.21.3...3.21.4)

### Bug fixes - Fix a killed tox (via SIGTERM) leaving the commands subprocesses running by handling it as if it were a KeyboardInterrupt by [@dajose](https://github.com/dajose) [#1772](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1772) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.21.3/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.21.2...3.21.3)

name: 4.0.0a5
body: ### Features - Support the `system_site_packages`/`sitepackages` flag for virtual environment based tox environments by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1847](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1847)) - Support the `always_copy`/`alwayscopy` flag for virtual environment based tox environments by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1848](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1848)) - Support the `download` flag for virtual environment based tox environments by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1849](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1849)) - Recreate virtual environment based tox environments when the `virtualenv` version changes by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1865](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1865)) ### Bug fixes - Not all package dependencies are installed when different tox environments in the same run use different set of extras by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1868](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1868)) - Support `=` separator in requirement file flags, directories as requirements and correctly set the root of the requirements file when using the `--root` CLI flag to change the root by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1853](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1853)) - Cleanup local subprocess file handlers when exiting runs (fixes `ResourceWarning: unclosed file` errors when running with `env PYTHONTRACEMALLOC=5 PYTHONDEVMODE=y` under a Python built with `--with-pydebug`) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1857](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1857)) - Various small bugfixes: - honor updating default environment variables set by internal tox via set env (`PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK`) - do not multi-wrap `HandledError` in the ini file loader, - skipped environments are logged now with their fail message at default verbosity level, - fix an error that made the show configuration command crash when making the string of a config value failed, - support empty-new lines within the set env configurations replacements, by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1864](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1864)) ### Documentation - Add CLI documentation by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1852](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1852)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.0.0a5/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.0.0a4...4.0.0a5)

### Bug fixes - Newer coverage tools update the `COV_CORE_CONTEXT` environment variable, add it to the list of environment variables that can change in our pytest plugin by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). [#1854](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1854) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.21.2/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.21.1...3.21.2)

name: 4.0.0a4
body: ### Features - Use `.tox/4` instead of `.tox4` folder (so ignores for tox 3 works for tox 4 too), reminder we'll rename this to just `.tox` before public release, however to encourage testing tox 4 in parallel with tox 3 this is helpful by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). (`1812`) - Colorize the `config` command: section headers are yellow, keys are green, values remained white, exceptions are light red and comments are cyan by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1821](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1821)) ### Bug fixes - Support legacy format (`-cconstraint.txt`) of constraint files in `deps`, and expand constraint files too when viewing inside the `deps` or calculating weather our environment is up to date or not by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1788](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1788)) - When specifying requirements/editable/constraint paths within `deps` escape space, unless already escaped to support running specifying transitive requirements files within deps by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1792](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1792)) - When using a provisioned tox environment requesting `--recreate` failed with `AttributeError` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1793](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1793)) - Fix `RequirementsFile` from tox is rendered incorrectly in `config` command by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1820](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1820)) - Fix a bug in the configuration system where referring to the same named key in another env/section causes circular dependency error by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1821](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1821)) - Raise `ValueError` with descriptive message when a requirements file specified does not exist by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1828](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1828)) - Support all valid requirement file specification without delimiting space in the `deps` of the `tox.ini` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1834](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1834)) ### Documentation - Add code style guide for contributors by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1734](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1734)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.0.0a4/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.0.0a3...4.0.0a4)

name: 4.0.0a3
body: ### Features - Raise exception when set env enters into a circular reference by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1779](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1779)) - - Raise exception when variable substitution enters into a circle. - Add `{/}` as substitution for os specific path separator. - Add `{env_bin_dir}` constant substitution. - Implement support for `--discover` flag by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1784](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1784)) ### Bug fixes - Entries in the `set_env` does not reference environments from `set_env` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1776](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1776)) - `env` substitution does not uses values from `set_env` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1779](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1779)) - Adopt tox 3 base pass env list, by adding: - on all platforms: `LANG`, `LANGUAGE`, `CURL_CA_BUNDLE`, `SSL_CERT_FILE` , `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` and `REQUESTS_CA_BUNLDE`, - on Windows: `SYSTEMDRIVE` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1780](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1780)) - Fixed a bug that crashed tox where calling tox with the recreate flag and when multiple environments were reusing the same package by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1782](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1782)) - - Python version markers are stripped in package dependencies (after wrongfully being detected as an extra marker). - In packaging APIs do not set `PYTHONPATH` (to empty string) if `backend-path` is empty. - Fix commands parsing on Windows (do not auto-escape `\` - instead users should use the new `{\}`, and on parsed arguments strip both `'` and `"` quoted outcomes). - Allow windows paths in substitution set/default (the `:` character used to separate substitution arguments may also be present in paths on Windows - do not support single capital letter values as substitution arguments) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1784](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1784)) - Rework how we handle Python packaging environments: - the base packaging environment changed from `.package` to `.pkg`, - merged the `sdist`, `wheel` and `dev` separate packaging implementations into one, and internally dynamically pick the one that's needed, - the base packaging environment always uses the same Python environment as tox is installed into, - the base packaging environment is used to get the metadata of the project (via PEP-517) and to build `sdist` and `dev` packages, - for building wheels introduced a new per env configurable option `wheel_build_env`, if the target Python major/minor and implementation for the run tox environment and the base package tox environment matches set this to `.pkg`, otherwise this is `.pkg-{implementation}{major}{minor}`, - internally now packaging environments can create further packaging environments they are responsible of managing, - updated `depends` to use the packaging logic, - add support skip missing interpreters for depends and show config, by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1804](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1804)) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.0.0a3/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.0.0a2...4.0.0a3)

### Features - Prevent .tox in envlist by [@jayvdb](https://github.com/jayvdb) [#1684](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1684) ### Bug fixes - Fix regression that broke using install_command in config replacements by [@jayvdb](https://github.com/jayvdb) [#1777](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1777) - Fix regression parsing posargs default containing colon. by [@jayvdb](https://github.com/jayvdb) [#1785](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1785) ### Packaging - Enable building tox with `setuptools_scm` 4 and 5 by [@hroncok](https://github.com/hroncok) [#1799](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1799) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.21.1/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.21.0...3.21.1)

name: 4.0.0a2
body: ### Features - Add option to disable colored output, and support `NO_COLOR` and `FORCE_COLOR` environment variables by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1630](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1630)) ### Bug fixes - Fix coverage generation in CI by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1551](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1551)) - Fix the CI failures: - drop Python 3.5 support as it's not expected to get to a release before EOL, - fix test using `\n` instead of `os.linesep`, - Windows Python 3.6 does not contain `_overlapped.ReadFileInto` by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1556](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1556)) ### Documentation - Add base documentation by merging virtualenv structure with tox 3 by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). ([#1551](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1551)) ### New Contributors - [@eumiro](https://github.com/eumiro) made their first contribution in [#1754](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1754) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/4.0.0a2/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/4.0.0a1...4.0.0a2)

### Features - Allow { and } in default of {env:key:default}. by [@jayvdb](https://github.com/jayvdb) [#1502](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1502) - Allow {posargs} in setenv. by [@jayvdb](https://github.com/jayvdb) [#1695](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1695) - Allow {/} to refer to os.sep. by [@jayvdb](https://github.com/jayvdb) [#1700](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1700) - Make parsing [testenv] sections in setup.cfg official. by [@mauvilsa](https://github.com/mauvilsa) [#1727](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1727) - Relax importlib requirement to allow 3.0.0 or any newer version by [@pkolbus](https://github.com/pkolbus) [#1763](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1763) ### Bug fixes - Fix the false `congratulations` message that appears when a `KeyboardInterrupt` occurs during package installation. by [@gnikonorov](https://github.com/gnikonorov) [#1453](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1453) - Fix `platform` support for `install_command`. by [@jayvdb](https://github.com/jayvdb) [#1464](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1464) - Fixed regression in v3.20.0 that caused escaped curly braces in setenv to break usage of the variable elsewhere in tox.ini. by [@jayvdb](https://github.com/jayvdb) [#1690](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1690) - Prevent `{}` and require `{:` is only followed by `}`. by [@jayvdb](https://github.com/jayvdb) [#1711](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1711) - Raise `MissingSubstitution` on access of broken ini setting. by [@jayvdb](https://github.com/jayvdb) [#1716](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1716) ### Documentation - Document more info about using `platform` setting. by [@prakhargurunani](https://github.com/prakhargurunani) [#1144](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1144) - Replace `indexserver` in documentation with environment variables by [@ziima](https://github.com/ziima). [#1357](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1357) - Document that the `passenv` environment setting is case insensitive. by [@gnikonorov](https://github.com/gnikonorov) [#1534](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1534) ### New Contributors - [@thomwiggers](https://github.com/thomwiggers) made their first contribution in [#1719](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1719) - [@gnikonorov](https://github.com/gnikonorov) made their first contribution in [#1723](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1723) - [@mauvilsa](https://github.com/mauvilsa) made their first contribution in [#1724](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1724) - [@ziima](https://github.com/ziima) made their first contribution in [#1728](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1728) - [@eli-schwartz](https://github.com/eli-schwartz) made their first contribution in [#1739](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1739) - [@xuhdev](https://github.com/xuhdev) made their first contribution in [#1751](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1751) - [@FirePing32](https://github.com/FirePing32) made their first contribution in [#1753](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1753) - [@Clivern](https://github.com/Clivern) made their first contribution in [#1756](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1756) - [@pkolbus](https://github.com/pkolbus) made their first contribution in [#1764](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1764) - [@alexmorley](https://github.com/alexmorley) made their first contribution in [#1766](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1766) - [@Gleland](https://github.com/Gleland) made their first contribution in [#1767](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1767) - [@christopherpickering](https://github.com/christopherpickering) made their first contribution in [#1770](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1770) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.21.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.20.1...3.21.0)

### Features - Support for comments within `setenv` and environment files via the `files|` prefix. by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) [#1667](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1667) ### Bug fixes - Allow hyphens and empty factors in generative section name. by [@tyagdit](https://github.com/tyagdit) [#1636](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1636) - Support for PEP517 in-tree build backend-path key in `get-build-requires`. by [@nizox](https://github.com/nizox) [#1654](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1654) - Allow escaping curly braces in setenv. by [@mkenigs](https://github.com/mkenigs) [#1656](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1656) ### New Contributors - [@Tyagdit](https://github.com/Tyagdit) made their first contribution in [#1647](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1647) - [@nizox](https://github.com/nizox) made their first contribution in [#1655](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1655) - [@mkenigs](https://github.com/mkenigs) made their first contribution in [#1656](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1656) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.20.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.19.0...3.20.0)

### Features - Implement support for building projects having [PEP 517](https://peps.python.org/pep-0517/#in-tree-build-backends) `backend-path` setting by [@webknjaz](https://github.com/webknjaz) [#1575](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1575) - Don't require a tox config file for `tox --devenv` by [@hroncok](https://github.com/hroncok) [#1643](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1643) ### Bug fixes - skip `setup.cfg` if it has no `tox:tox` namespace by [@hroncok](https://github.com/hroncok) [#1045](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1045) ### Documentation - Fixed grammar in top-level documentation by [@tfurf](https://github.com/tfurf) [#1631](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1631) ### New Contributors - [@tfurf](https://github.com/tfurf) made their first contribution in [#1631](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1631) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.19.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.18.1...3.19.0)

### Deprecations - Add allowlist_externals alias to whitelist_externals (whitelist_externals is now deprecated). by [@dajose](https://github.com/dajose) [#1491](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1491) ### New Contributors - [@dajose](https://github.com/dajose) made their first contribution in [#1601](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1601) - [@slsh1o](https://github.com/slsh1o) made their first contribution in [#1622](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1622) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.18.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.17.1...3.18.0)

### Features - The long arguments `--verbose` and `--quiet` (rather than only their short forms, `-v` and `-q`) are now accepted. [#1612](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1612) - The `ResultLog` now prefers `HOSTNAME` environment variable value (if set) over the full qualified domain name of localhost. This makes it possible to disable an undesired DNS lookup, which happened on all `tox` invocations, including trivial ones by [@hroncok](https://github.com/hroncok) [#1615](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1615) ### Documentation - Update packaging information for Flit. ### Features - Allow skipping the package and installation step when passing the `--skip-pkg-install`. This should be used in pair with the `--notest`, so you can separate environment setup and test run: .. code-block:: console tox -e py --notest tox -e py --skip-pkg-install by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). [#1605](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1605) ### Performance - Improve config parsing performance by precompiling commonly used regular expressions by [@brettlangdon](https://github.com/brettlangdon) [#1603](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/1603) ### New Contributors - [@brettlangdon](https://github.com/brettlangdon) made their first contribution in [#1603](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/1603) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/3.16.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/3.15.2...3.16.0)

### Features - Virtual environments created now no longer upgrade pip/wheel/setuptools to the latest version. Instead the start packages after virtualenv creation now is whatever virtualenv has bundled in. This allows faster virtualenv creation and builds that are easier to reproduce. [#448](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/448) - Improve python discovery and add architecture support: - UNIX: - First, check if the tox host Python matches. - Second, check if the the canonical name (e.g. `python3.7`, `python3`) matches or the base python is an absolute path, use that. - Third, check if the the canonical name without version matches (e.g. `python`, `pypy`) matches. - Windows: - First, check if the tox host Python matches. - Second, use the `py.exe` to list registered interpreters and any of those match. - Third, check if the the canonical name (e.g. `python3.7`, `python3`) matches or the base python is an absolute path, use that. - Fourth, check if the the canonical name without version matches (e.g. `python`, `pypy`) matches. - Finally, check for known locations (`c:\python{major}{minor}\python.exe`). tox environment configuration generation is now done in parallel (to alleviate the slowdown due to extra checks). ([#773](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/773)) - (only affected rc releases) Revert breaking change of tox.cmdline not callable with no args by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat). name: 3.0.0rc1
body: ### Features - Add a `-q` option to progressively silence tox's output. For each time you specify `-q` to tox, the output provided by tox reduces. This option allows you to see only your command output without the default verbosity of what tox is doing. This also counter-acts usage of `-v`. For example, running `tox -v -q ...` will provide you with the default verbosity. `tox -vv -q` is equivalent to `tox -v`. By [@sigmavirus24](https://github.com/sigmavirus24) ([#256](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/256)) - add support for negated factor conditions, e.g. `!dev: production_log` by [@jurko-gospodnetic](https://github.com/jurko-gospodnetic) ([#292](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/292)) - Headings like `installed: ` will not be printed if there is no output to display after the :, unless verbosity is set. By [@cryvate](https://github.com/cryvate) ([#601](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/601)) - Allow spaces in command line options to pip in deps. Where previously only `deps=-rreq.txt` and `deps=--requirement=req.txt` worked, now also `deps=-r req.txt` and `deps=--requirement req.txt` work by [@cryvate](https://github.com/cryvate) ([#668](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/668)) - drop Python `2.6` and `3.3` support: `setuptools` dropped supporting these, and as we depend on it we'll follow up with doing the same (use `tox <= 2.9.1` if you still need this support) by [@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat) ([#679](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/679)) - Add tox_runenvreport as a possible plugin, allowing the overriding of the default behavior to execute a command to get the installed packages within a virtual environment by [@tonybaloney](https://github.com/tonybaloney) ([#725](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/725)) - Forward `PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE` by default on Windows to fix `platform.machine()`. ([#740](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/740)) ### Changes - The `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE` environment variable is no longer unset by [@stephenfin](https://github.com/stephenfin). ([#744](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/744)) ### Bug fixes - Write directly to stdout buffer if possible to prevent str vs bytes issues by [@asottile](https://github.com/asottile) ([#426](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/426)) - fix #672 reporting to json file when skip-missing-interpreters option is used by [@r2dan](https://github.com/r2dan) ([#672](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/672)) - avoid `Requested Python version (X.Y) not installed` stderr output when a Python environment is looked up using the `py` Python launcher on Windows and the environment is not found installed on the system by [@jurko-gospodnetic](https://github.com/jurko-gospodnetic) ([#692](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/692)) - Fixed an issue where invocation of Tox from the Python package, where invocation errors (failed actions) occur results in a change in the sys.stdout stream encoding in Python 3.x. New behavior is that sys.stdout is reset back to its original encoding after invocation errors by [@tonybaloney](https://github.com/tonybaloney) ([#723](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/723)) - The reading of command output sometimes failed with `IOError: [Errno 0] Error` on Windows, this was fixed by using a simpler method to update the read buffers. by [@fschulze](https://github.com/fschulze) ([#727](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/727)) - Running `tox` without a `setup.py` now has a more friendly error message and gives troubleshooting suggestions by [@Volcyy](https://github.com/Volcyy). ### Changes - [pull request 599](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/599): fix problems with implementation of [#515](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/515). Substitutions from other sections were not made anymore if they were not in `envlist`. Thanks to Clark Boylan ([@cboylan](https://github.com/cboylan)) for helping to get this fixed ([pull request 597](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/597)). ### New Contributors - [@cboylan](https://github.com/cboylan) made their first contribution in [#597](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/597) [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/2.8.1/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/2.8.0...2.8.1)

### Changes - [#301](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/301): Expand nested substitutions in `tox.ini`. Thanks [@vlaci](https://github.com/vlaci). Thanks to Eli Collins ([@eli-collins](https://github.com/eli-collins)) for creating a reproducer. - [#429](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/429): Forward `MSYSTEM` by default on Windows. Thanks Marius Gedminas ([@mgedmin](https://github.com/mgedmin)) for reporting this. - [#484](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/484): Renamed `py.test` to `pytest` throughout the project. Thanks Slam ([@3lnc](https://github.com/3lnc)). - [#504](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/504): With `-a`: do not show additional environments header if there are none. Thanks [@rndr](https://github.com/rndr). - [#515](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/515): Don't require environment variables in test environments where they are not used. Thanks André Caron ([@AndreLouisCaron](https://github.com/AndreLouisCaron)). - [#517](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/517): Forward `NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS` by default on Windows to fix `multiprocessor.cpu_count()`. Thanks André Caron ([@AndreLouisCaron](https://github.com/AndreLouisCaron)). - [#518](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/518): Forward `USERPROFILE` by default on Windows. Thanks André Caron ([@AndreLouisCaron](https://github.com/AndreLouisCaron)). - [pull request 528](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/528): Fix some of the warnings displayed by pytest 3.1.0. Thanks Bruno Oliveira ([@nicoddemus](https://github.com/nicoddemus)). - [pull request 547](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/547): Add regression test for [#137](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/137). Thanks Martin Andrysík ([@sifuraz](https://github.com/sifuraz)). - [pull request 553](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/553): Add an XFAIL test to reproduce upstream bug [#203](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/203). Thanks Bartolomé Sánchez Salado ([@bartsanchez](https://github.com/bartsanchez)). - [pull request 580](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/580): Do not ignore Sphinx warnings anymore. Thanks Bernát Gábor ([@gaborbernat](https://github.com/gaborbernat)). - [pull request 588](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/588): Run pytest with xfail_strict and adapt affected tests. ### Bug fixes - [#326](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/326): Fix `OSError` 'Not a directory' when creating env on Jython 2.7.0. Thanks Nick Douma ([@LordGaav](https://github.com/LordGaav)). - [pull request 556](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/556): Report more meaningful errors on why virtualenv creation failed. Thanks [@vlaci](https://github.com/vlaci). Also thanks to Igor Sadchenko ([@igor-sadchenko](https://github.com/igor-sadchenko)) for pointing out a problem with that PR before it hit the masses ☺ ### Documentation - [#276](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/276): Remove easy_install from docs (TL;DR: use pip). Thanks Martin Andrysík ([@sifuraz](https://github.com/sifuraz)). - [#315](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/315): add `--help` and `--version` to helptox-quickstart. Thanks [@vlaci](https://github.com/vlaci). - [#449](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/449): add multi platform example to the docs. Thanks Aleks Bunin ([@sashkab](https://github.com/sashkab)) and [@rndr](https://github.com/rndr). - [pull request 575](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/575): Add announcement doc to end all announcement docs (using only `CHANGELOG` and Github issues since 2.5 already). - [pull request 585](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/pull/585): Expand documentation to explain pass through of flags from deps to pip (e.g. `-rrequirements.txt`, `-cconstraints.txt`). Thanks Alexander Loechel ([@loechel](https://github.com/loechel)). ### Packaging - [#474](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/issues/474): Start using setuptools_scm for tag based versioning. [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/tox/2.8.0/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/tox-dev/tox/compare/2.8.0rc2...2.8.0)
